title: Analyst Software Engineering - ServiceNow Platform Production Support-Tier 1
description:
**Role:**
ServiceNow Platform Production Support– Tier 1
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ years (with Certified ServiceNow Administrator)
  
  
**Role Summary**
The ServiceNow Platform Production Support Tier 1 Analyst is responsible for providing first-level technical support for the ServiceNow platform. This role focuses on incident logging, initial troubleshooting, user support, request fulfilment, and timely escalation to higher support tiers when required. The ideal candidate should have deep ServiceNow knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced support environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Incident Management**

* Monitor ServiceNow queues and handle incoming incidents and service requests.
* Log, categorize, and prioritize incidents based on impact and urgency.
* Perform initial troubleshooting using knowledge articles and standard procedures.
* Resolve common issues within defined SLAs.
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams with proper documentation.

**Request Fulfilment**

* Process standard service requests such as:

+ User access requests
+ Basic configuration requests
+ Catalog request fulfilment
+ Tenant Application Code Deployment Requests

* Ensure requests are completed within SLA timelines.

**Monitoring & Alerts**

* Monitor system alerts, logs, dashboards, and integrations.
* Acknowledge alerts and initiate predefined recovery actions where applicable.
* Notify appropriate teams during system outages or performance degradation.

**User Support**

* Provide first-level support to end users via portal, email.
* Assist users with navigation and usage of ServiceNow modules.
* Maintain clear communication with users regarding incident status and updates.

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks.
* Create and update knowledge articles for recurring issues.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation and resolution notes.

**SLA & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to SLAs and operational procedures.
* Maintain quality and compliance with support standards.
* Participate in shift handovers and daily operational reviews.

**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**

* Good understanding of ServiceNow platform
* Expertise in modules such as:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Knowledge Management

* Good understanding of ITIL concepts
* Good troubleshooting skills in:

+ User access issues
+ Portal navigation
+ Standard ServiceNow workflows
+ Integration Flows
+ Authentications Method

* Understanding of ticketing tools and support processes

**Soft Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication
* Good customer service mindset
* Ability to work in rotational shifts
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to follow documented processes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialists(CIS) in any modules
* ITIL Foundation Certification – preferred
* Solid Understanding of:

+ Active Directory
+ User management
+ Email and notification troubleshooting
+ Update Sets and Deployment method

* Exposure to ServiceNow support environment is a plus

**Weekly Hours**
40
  
  
**Time Type**
Regular
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India, Hyderabad, India

title: Sr Associate IS Engineer – WINTEL Operations
description:

**Please note, this is an on-site role based in Hyderabad.**

* Administer, monitor, and support Windows Server(s)

* Perform patching, updates and backups to ensure compliance
* Support in incident resolution and troubleshooting
* Document changes and standard operating procedures

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with 4-6 years of experience OR
* Master’s degree with 2–4 years of experience OR

**Functional Skills**
**Must-Have Skills:**

* Experience with Windows server operations
* Experience with virtualization (VMware, Acropolis)
* Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell, Ansible, Python)
* Familiarity with ITIL or incident management workflows
* Change management expertise

**Good-to-Have Skills**

**Professional Certifications**

**Soft Skills**

* Detail-oriented and organized
* Effective communicator
* Ability to follow procedures accurately
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

This position is required to be onsite and participate in 24/7 rotation fashion and may require you to work a later shift. Candidates must be willing and able to work off hours, as required based on business requirements.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. title: Arena Application / Production Support Engineer
description:
Strong working knowledge of Unix/Linux commands and operating-system fundamentals. Hands-on experience in shell scripting for task automation and operational support. Working knowledge of Python scripting. Understanding of cloud-computing fundamentals, preferably AWS. Experience or working knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem. Knowledge of HDFS and Hive. Experience supporting applications or tools in production environments. Ability to analyze application, server and system logs. Understanding of incident, problem and change-management processes. Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform. Experience working with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk. Basic understanding of Git or another version-control system. Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. The internal Arena requirements include Hadoop ecosystem knowledge, particularly HDFS and Hive, monitoring through Dynatrace and Splunk, Python-based automation, scripting, Git, Linux/Unix and cloud fundamentals. Apache Hadoop documentation also confirms that Hadoop functionality is managed extensively through shell commands, scripts and runtime environment variables. Preferred Skills Experience supporting Arena, Alation, Manta or similar enterprise tools. Exposure to AWS services and cloud-based application environments. Knowledge of Rally for user-story and feature tracking. Experience with application monitoring and log-analysis tools. Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases. Knowledge of scheduling and batch-processing tools. Experience with access, user-role and permission management. Familiarity with release, deployment and server-patching activities. Exposure to automation and continuous service-improvement initiatives. Experience working in a 24/7 or globally distributed support environment.
  
  
Administer, monitor and support the Arena application across production and non-production environments. Perform routine application, server, service and component health checks. Monitor application availability, system performance, logs, alerts and scheduled processes. Troubleshoot production issues, application failures, connectivity problems and environmental errors. Analyze Unix/Linux logs and execute commands to identify application and server-level issues. Develop and maintain shell scripts to automate routine monitoring and support activities. Use Python to automate repetitive operational tasks, reporting and health checks. Provide operational support for Hadoop ecosystem components, including HDFS and Hive. Monitor Hadoop jobs and investigate job failures, storage issues and data-processing problems. Perform initial analysis and troubleshooting before escalating complex issues to L2/L3, infrastructure or engineering teams. Handle incidents, service requests, problems and changes through ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform. Ensure tickets are prioritized, updated and resolved within defined SLA timelines. Perform root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and coordinate permanent fixes with relevant technical teams. Support application services during server patching, maintenance, deployment and release activities. Coordinate with infrastructure, database, network, cloud and application teams for issue resolution. Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, access-related problems and environmental configuration issues. Maintain SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles and operational documentation. Participate in shift-based support and on-call rotations based on project requirements. Provide timely incident and service-status updates to technical and business stakeholders. These responsibilities align with the internal Arena\_Junior\_level\_job posting (1) and Arena\_Mid\_level\_job posting (1), which cover Arena monitoring, health checks, RCA, ServiceNow ticket handling, patching support, documentation and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability. Ownership of incidents from assignment through resolution. Ability to prioritize tasks in a production-support environment. Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams. Customer-focused approach and clear stakeholder communication. Ability to work independently and within a shift-based support team. Willingness to learn new applications, tools and technologies. Education Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.

title: Senior Associate IS Engineer – Storage & Backup Operations

Please note, this is an on-site role based in Hyderabad.

* Ensures services are aligned with the key principles of service ownership which includes - meeting the needs of the business, scalability, compliance, reliability, resilience & security

* Contribute to SOP & Runbook Design, Development, and ongoing updates

* Investigate and resolve storage & backup related technical issues. Participate in rotational 24x7 On-Call Support at the SME level and assist/lead Root Cause Analysis reviews
* Handling and monitor data replication, using Dell, NetApp & Rubrik replication technologies within strong understanding of RPO/RTO compliance parameters
* Help build AI-agentic solutions and flows to automate manual storage and backup tasks using skills on Powershell, Python, REST APIs and preferably over ServiceNow workflows

* Master’s degree and 3/3+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage, Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting or
* Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage/Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting, or

* 5+ years’ experience with NetApp, DellEMC Isilon and DR/BCM replication technologies

description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer**
Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Experience: Minimum 5-7 years
  
  
**Qualification**
B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience
  
  
OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Certifications Required**
OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:
  
  
Cisco SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage.
  
  
CEH certified
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.
  
  
The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  
  
Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  
  
Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.
  
  
Analyze SD-WAN alarms, events, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve network incidents.
  
  
Configure and troubleshoot application-aware routing, traffic steering, SLA-based path selection, QoS, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Perform configuration and policy changes through centralized SD-WAN management and orchestration platforms.
  
  
Implement SD-WAN policies, templates, profiles, routing configurations, security policies, and application-based traffic steering as per approved requirements.
  
  
Support deployment and implementation of new SD-WAN sites, branches, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
  
  
Participate in SD-WAN migration projects, including migration from traditional MPLS-based networks to SD-WAN solutions.
  
  
Perform SD-WAN edge device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and validation activities.
  
  
Support integration of SD-WAN with existing network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Internet gateways, and cloud platforms.
  
  
Perform health checks, configuration backups, software upgrades, firmware upgrades, and patch management for SD-WAN infrastructure.
  
  
Troubleshoot performance issues related to latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth utilization, and application performance.
  
  
Coordinate with ISPs and telecom service providers for resolution of WAN link-related incidents and performance issues.
  
  
Work with L1 and L3 teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SD-WAN incidents and service-impacting issues.
  
  
Participate in the incident, problem, and change management processes and ensure compliance with defined ITIL processes and SLAs.
  
  
Validate and implement approved SD-WAN change requests, including impact assessment, implementation planning, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  
  
Support SD-WAN high-availability configurations, redundancy testing, failover testing, and DR drills.
  
  
Perform planned and emergency changes during maintenance windows and ensure proper post-change validation.
  
  
Support troubleshooting and implementation of SD-WAN security features, including IPsec encryption, segmentation, secure connectivity, and integration with next-generation firewalls.
  
  
Support network segmentation using VPN/VRF and SD-WAN segmentation policies based on business and security requirements.
  
  
Perform configuration-level remediation activities identified through vulnerability assessments, security audits, and compliance reviews.
  
  
Analyze and act upon OEM advisories, security vulnerabilities, bug notifications, and recommended software upgrades relevant to SD-WAN platforms.
  
  
Maintain updated network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation documents, SOPs, MOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
  
  
Create and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring SD-WAN incidents, known errors, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
  
  
Prepare operational reports covering SD-WAN availability, incidents, link performance, SLA compliance, capacity utilization, and recurring issues.
  
  
Generate reports and dashboards related to SD-WAN health, network performance, incidents, and service trends.
  
  
Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for operational reporting, data analysis, and management presentations.
  
  
Coordinate with OEM support teams for complex technical issues and track cases through resolution.
  
  
Participate in technology refresh, capacity expansion, and SD-WAN optimization initiatives.
  
  
Continuously optimize SD-WAN configurations and policies to improve network availability, application performance, and bandwidth utilization.
  
  
Ensure compliance with defined security policies, operational procedures, change management processes, and SLA requirements.
  
  
Maintain awareness of the latest SD-WAN features, technologies, best practices, and product enhancements from Cisco, Fortinet, Versa, and other relevant OEMs.
  
  
**Technical Skills / Desired Competencies**
Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking and SD-WAN operations.
  
  
Good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, control plane, data plane, management plane, and orchestration components.
  
  
**Hands-on Experience With One Or More Of**
Cisco SD-WAN / Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN
  
  
Fortinet Secure SD-WAN / FortiGate
  
  
Versa SD-WAN
  
  
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, NAT, DNS, DHCP, ACL, IPsec, GRE, and routing concepts.
  
  
Good hands-on knowledge of BGP, OSPF, static routing, route redistribution, and routing policies.
  
  
Good understanding of MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G and hybrid WAN connectivity.
  
  
Experience in troubleshooting IPsec tunnels, overlay/underlay connectivity, routing issues, packet loss, latency, jitter, and application performance.
  
  
Knowledge of QoS, application-aware routing, traffic engineering, and dynamic path selection.
  
  
Understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, segmentation, secure tunnels, encryption, and security policies.
  
  
Experience with SD-WAN monitoring, centralized management, orchestration, and analytics platforms.
  
  
Ability to perform packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark, ping, traceroute, and vendor-specific troubleshooting utilities.
  
  
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to handle critical network incidents under SLA-driven operations.
  
  
Ability to work in a multi-vendor environment and adapt to different OEM technologies and operational processes.
  
  
Strong communication and coordination skills for working with L1/L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and client stakeholders.
  
  
Willingness to work in 24 7 operations / rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required by business needs.
  
  
Strong documentation and reporting skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent network diagramming tools.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience in large enterprise or managed services environments.
  
  
Experience supporting geographically distributed branch networks.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN implementation, migration, and rollout projects.
  
  
Experience in multi-vendor SD-WAN environments involving Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa.
  
  
Experience in managing critical incidents and participating in major incident management processes.
  
  
Experience in network automation, API-based configuration, or SD-WAN orchestration is an added advantage.
  
  
Experience working with ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management processes.

**nights**
a week in for cross over time with PST leadership)
  
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Business Systems Analystrole offers an exciting opportunity to join a small, high-performing technology team supporting the Results Delivery Office (RDO).
  
  
This role will serve as a technical analyst supporting the technology roadmap for RDO, including new and existing AI products, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint-based products, Power Automate solutions, and related digital capabilities. The ideal candidate is a customer-focused, hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into clear requirements, help shape solution direction, support build and configuration activities, and provide white-glove service to stakeholders who expect a high-touch partnership model. This role will be responsible for both helping build and launch new products and enhancements, as well as maintaining, supporting, and continuously improving existing AI, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and automation products after go-live.
  
  
This is a versatile, hands-on role suited for someone who can wear many hats across business analysis, product support, roadmap planning, low-code/no-code automation, AI solution enablement, documentation, testing, release support, and operational maintenance. The role is especially well suited for a technically minded analyst or engineer who enjoys client-facing work, thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to help a small team deliver high-value technology outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Partner with RDO leaders, business stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and vendors to understand business objectives and translate them into actionable technology roadmap items, features, user stories, and requirements.
* Support new and existing AI products, including intake, use case discovery, requirements definition, process mapping, testing, adoption support, and ongoing maintenance activities.
* Support SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Power Automate-based products and workflows, including enhancements, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Capture the voice of the customer and deliver white-glove support through proactive communication, strong follow-through, and clear expectation management.
* Elicit, document, and refine business, functional, non-functional, data, reporting, security, privacy, and operational requirements.
* Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, use cases, test scenarios, and lightweight solution documentation.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize product backlogs, release scopes, maintenance needs, defects, and enhancement requests.

* Assist with solution design, configuration, testing, validation, and deployment for AI-enabled tools, SharePoint solutions, Power Automate flows, dashboards, and related digital capabilities.
* Support proofs of concept, pilots, and experiments for AI, automation, and collaboration solutions, including success criteria, risk considerations, stakeholder feedback, and transition-to-production planning.
* Use internal AI capabilities and approved tools to improve productivity, summarize information, support analysis, develop drafts, and identify opportunities for process automation.
* Support responsible AI practices by helping document business purpose, expected outcomes, risks, controls, human review points, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled solutions.
* Perform initial triage, troubleshooting, and support coordination for product issues, data questions, access requests, workflow failures, and user feedback.
* Coordinate small enhancements and maintenance activities across a lean team of approximately three resources, flexing between build, run, analysis, testing, documentation, and stakeholder support as needed.
* Prepare and deliver product demonstrations, training materials, walkthroughs, and stakeholder updates for business and technology audiences.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, increase adoption, and improve user experience.
* Operate effectively in Agile delivery models while adapting to other frameworks and ways of working as needed for the business group.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field AND
* 4+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, technology analysis, product analysis, digital solutions, information systems, engineering, or a related technology delivery role.
* Experience supporting business stakeholders in a client-facing or product-support capacity.
* Experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, or another regulated industry is an added advantage.

**Functional Skills**
**Must-Have Skills**

* Business analysis experience, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, user story creation, acceptance criteria, testing support, documentation, and stakeholder management.

* Experience with Power Platform capabilities, especially Power Automate; exposure to Power Apps and Power BI is preferred.
* Ability to partner with technical teams to support solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with ability to investigate issues, synthesize information, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate technical or complex concepts into business-friendly language.
* Ability to work independently in a small team, manage multiple priorities, and flex across build, run, support, documentation, and stakeholder engagement responsibilities.

**Role Statement**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Performance & Quality Senior Analyst ensures work is efficiently prioritized, planned, and delivered across the ERP Tech Factory (ERP Core Customization, Custom Application Development & APEX, ERP Operational Reporting, and Test Automation Factory).
  
  
The role owns intake demand management and capacity planning—ensuring requests are transparently prioritized, sized, and allocated against available capacity in a predictable cadence. In parallel, the Analyst drives process standardization, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, embedding repeatable practices and quality checkpoints across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
As a member of the Tech Factory Lead's staff, the role provides executive visibility into throughput, performance, and quality trends—enabling data-driven decisions on prioritization, resourcing, and delivery optimization.
  
  
**Key Duties**
**Intake Demand Management**

* Own and manage the intake process for new requests (enhancements, fixes, test, reporting needs) across the four Tech Factory pods.
* Define and maintain intake criteria, templates, and qualification checkpoints to ensure completeness and readiness of incoming demand.
* Oversee and ensure that requests are triaged and routed to the appropriate pillar/team based on scope, complexity, and priority.
* Maintain a consolidated demand backlog, ensuring visibility and traceability from intake to delivery.

**Capacity Planning & Resource Allocation**

* Build and maintain capacity planning across ERP core customization, Custom application development & APEX, ERP Operating Reporting and Test Automation Factory Pods.
* Monitor team utilization and forecast capacity against incoming demand, flagging bottlenecks or over/under-allocation.
* Support the Tech Factory Lead in balancing internal vs external resources and in sequencing the delivery roadmap.
* Provide scenario planning (what-if analysis) to support prioritization decisions during planning cycles.

**Process Standardization & Repeatability**

* Design, document, and maintain standardized workflows and delivery processes across the Tech Factory to ensure consistency and repeatability.
* Identify variability and inefficiencies in current processes, proposing streamlined, repeatable alternatives.
* Define and roll out quality checkpoints/gates across the delivery lifecycle (design, build, test, release), in alignment with the Tech Factory Lead.

Performance & Quality Monitoring
  
  

* Define, track, and report key performance and quality metrics across the Tech Factory (e.g. throughput, cycle time, delivery predictability, defect rates, and conversion of requests to delivery).
* Analyze trends and patterns to identify systemic issues, recurring bottlenecks, or quality risks.[NS1.1]
* Produce regular dashboards/reports for the Tech Factory Lead and stakeholders, highlighting performance against targets.

**Continuous Improvement & Governance**

* Recommend continuous improvement initiatives based on data insights, for review and validation by the Tech Factory Lead.
* Partner with Tech Factory Pods to embed best practices and process discipline.
* Maintain process documentation, playbooks, and knowledge assets to support onboarding and consistency across teams.
* Support governance activities by preparing structured inputs and materials for the Weekly Tech Operations Sync, Release & Technical Alignment meetings, and Monthly Platform Review
* Promote a culture of predictability, transparency, and continuous improvement within the Tech Factory, under the guidance of the Tech Factory Lead.

**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in a demand/capacity planning, process improvement, PMO, or business/process analyst role, ideally within an IT or ERP delivery environment.
* Proven experience designing and managing intake processes and capacity planning frameworks.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.
* Experience defining and tracking performance/quality KPIs and building reporting dashboards.
* Experience in software/ERP delivery lifecycles (development, testing, release management).
* Strong process-orientation, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.
* Experience in Agile/Lean methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma).
* Experience with planning/reporting tools (e.g. ServiceNow, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
* Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Intake-to-delivery cycle time
* Forecast accuracy of capacity planning vs. actual utilization
* Delivery predictability rate (planned vs. actual delivery dates)
* Process adherence/compliance rate across the Tech Factory
* Reduction in process variability/rework rate

**About Us**
**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**
**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:**
Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
  
  
**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**

* High-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**

* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent & open communication

**About Vertiv**
Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. title: Engineer II - Cloud Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
At LPL, observability is how a Tier 1 financial firm earns trust at midnight — and Engineer 2 Monitoring engineers spend their day in the dashboards, alerts, and incident channels that make that trust real. You'll grow into observability depth across CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (with the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow inside the Monitoring pod within Foundations, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring close at hand. If you want to learn observability at a Tier 1 financial firm with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Monitoring Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level observability engineer in the Monitoring pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support the implementation and operations of LPL's CCOE observability platform across our multi-account landing zone and the hybrid on-premises footprint. The stack spans AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch), Grafana / Prometheus (including Amazon Managed Prometheus and Managed Grafana where appropriate), Dynatrace, the legacy ELK stack where it still exists, and ServiceNow for ITSM and incident ticketing. You partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring, and you partner closely with the Support team on incident response and the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod on the observability paved road for application teams. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in dashboards, alerts, Terraform, and incident response — primarily as a primary on-call responder with support from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, SLO definitions, and runbooks across the CCOE observability stack: CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (and the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow ITSM
* Implement Terraform and Helm changes against the observability paved road; consume the private Terraform module library and raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared observability modules and reference dashboards
* Partner with the Support team on incident response: tune alert routing into ServiceNow, execute runbooks, and feed lessons from incidents back into durable monitoring improvements
* Pair with senior engineers and AVPs in the Monitoring pod on noisy alert chains, missing-signal investigations, and SLO refactors; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day observability work: AI-assisted alert triage, dashboard drafts from natural-language intent, summary of recent telemetry during incidents via MCP-backed agents, and runbook generation for known incident classes
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Working knowledge of an enterprise observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting — across AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch) and at least one of Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace (or comparable APM), or the ELK stack

**Core Competencies**

* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description

**Preferences**

* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day-to-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: Senior Oracle EBS Technical Resource (iStore)
description:
**Position: Senior Oracle EBS Technical Resource (iStore)**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Duration: Full Time**

**Rate: $ Open/Year**

**Need Local resource who can join in 2 Weeks**

**Job Description:**

Seeking an experienced Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Technical Resource to audit, remediate, and harden custom Oracle iStore applications.

The primary focus is eliminating critical application security vulnerabilities across custom Java Server Pages (JSPs), Java controllers, and database extensions without disrupting customer-facing e-commerce operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Refactor and remediate insecure custom JSPs, Java classes, and servlets, targeting OWASP Top 10 risks (Cross-Site Scripting [XSS], SQL Injection, CSRF, insecure direct object references, and sensitive data exposure).

Implement rigorous input validation, context-aware output encoding, and secure session handling adhering to Oracle Application Object Library (AOL) and Java security standards.

Secure underlying PL/SQL packages, APIs, and custom database integrations that interact with the iStore front end.

Collaborate with QA and InfoSec teams to validate fixes, conduct regression testing across the order flow, and package deployments via standard FND load and patching processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Oracle EBS Core: 6+ years of hands-on technical development experience with Oracle iStore (12.1.x or 12.2.x) and Oracle E-Business Suite frameworks.

Java / Web Technologies: Strong proficiency in Java, J2EE, custom JSP development, Java Servlets, and XML.

Application Security: Direct experience remediating web application security vulnerabilities within Oracle ERP environments.

Database / Backend: Strong PL/SQL and SQL skills, with experience securing custom database packages and standard Oracle APIs.

Architecture: In-depth understanding of Oracle Application Server / WebLogic configurations relevant to custom JSP deployments.

title: Senior Associate IS Engineer – Storage & Backup Operations
description:
**About The Role**
**Role Description:**
Amgen is seeking a Senior Associate Storage & Backup operation Engineer who, along with daily systems management tasks, will support Infrastructure Operations, having primary responsibility for activities related to ongoing Enterprise Storage & Backup support, automation, configuration, and operations management. While responsible for ongoing improvement of processes and applying best practices for the environment, the incumbent Sr Associate will work on Storage & Backup related technologies that will be introduced into the Amgen environment containing NetApp, Isilon, Rubrik & Netbackup Technologies.
  
  
Please note, this is an on-site role based in Hyderabad.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Support the Operations lead in the support, delivery, and continuous improvement of the technology services
* Ensures services are aligned with the key principles of service ownership which includes - meeting the needs of the business, scalability, compliance, reliability, resilience & security
* Assist Service Owner and Architect in detailed resource planning for vendors and IT teams based on the prioritized project list
* Perform necessary storage & backup infrastructure maintenance in accordance with Dell, NetApp & Rubrik best practices and Company Change Management policies
* Contribute to SOP & Runbook Design, Development, and ongoing updates
* Contribute to ongoing recommendations and best practices in Business Continuity, Migration, High Availability, Backup, Recovery, and Archiving
* Investigate and resolve storage & backup related technical issues. Participate in rotational 24x7 On-Call Support at the SME level and assist/lead Root Cause Analysis reviews
* Handling and monitor data replication, using Dell, NetApp & Rubrik replication technologies within strong understanding of RPO/RTO compliance parameters
* Help build AI-agentic solutions and flows to automate manual storage and backup tasks using skills on Powershell, Python, REST APIs and preferably over ServiceNow workflows
* Work directly with users to resolve support issues within product team responsibilities

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master’s degree and 3/3+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage, Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting or
* Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage/Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting, or

**Preferred Domain-specific Technical Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience with NetApp, DellEMC Isilon and DR/BCM replication technologies
* 3+ years’ experience in on-prem storage, backup and archiving solutions, and off-premise public cloud backup, archiving, and DR solutions (preferably AWS else Azure)
* 2-3 years’ experience handling backup/data protection technologies, preferably Rubrik and its replication cluster setup
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with installing and managing NetApp and DELL Isilon with local and remote replication using SyncIQ, Snapmirror & Snapvault
* Proficiency in Provisioning, Configuring and Administering zero RPO and low RTO for enterprise mission critical applications
* Good understanding of S3 protocol, buckets, objects, versioning, lifecycle and object-lock/WORM concepts.
* Basic experience in operating access management, ILM policies, including copy placement, retention, replication, and erasure codes
* Familiarity with StorageGRID networking: admin/grid/client networks, DNS, load balancers, certificates, firewall ports, and endpoint configurations
* Ability to troubleshoot with appropriate storage management tools complex database performance and trend analyzing issues
* Good scripting skills with data-driven problem solving and analytical skills

**Professional Certifications (preferred)**

* NCDA (NetApp Certified Data Administrator, ONTAP)
* Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA)

**Preferred Infrastructure Skills And Operations Experience**

* Demonstrated experience as part of a high-performance team, skilled in persuasion, and negotiation of critical issues, along with a background of solid systems administration processes and procedures
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams and Business Units to build strong solutions that meet the requirements Demonstrated experience with Windows/UNIX/Linux Operating systems
* ITIL experience and managing regulated systems within Life Sciences sector is a plus
* Working knowledge of Application Server Clustering and HA configurations
* Good grasp of TCP/IP networking fundamentals

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Problem-solving and critical thinking capabilities
* Team collaboration and knowledge sharing
* Adaptability to changing priorities and technologies
* Ability to follow procedures accurately.
* Willingness to learn and grow.

title: Junior IT Analyst
description:
We are building a team of trailblazers, who embody growth, impact, and excellence.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Junior IT Analyst to join our growing IT team. This role is ideal for someone early in their IT career who is eager to learn, enjoys helping people, and wants hands-on exposure to enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and user support operations.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is proactive, approachable, curious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced IT environment. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, takes ownership of tasks, communicates effectively, and is always willing to support teammates and employees with a positive attitude.
  
  
This is primarily a support-oriented role, so outstanding customer service and communication skills are just as important as technical ability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the first point of contact for employees needing IT assistance
* Deliver excellent customer service through all employee interactions
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, endpoint, and access issues
* Support Windows desktop environments and Microsoft 365 applications
* Assist with Windows Server, Active Directory (AD), and domain services administration
* Support cloud-based systems, ideally Microsoft Azure and Entra ID
* Escalate complex technical issues when needed while maintaining ownership and communication
* Handle onboarding/offboarding processes and device provisioning
* Assist with endpoint management tools such as Intune and Windows Autopilot
* Help maintain IT asset inventory and documentation
* Support basic networking and infrastructure troubleshooting
* Assist with security-related operational tasks
* Support internal reporting and monitoring activities as needed
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve the employee IT experience

title: Associate proactive Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Description**
**About Salesforce
  
  
Salesforce is the world's #1 CRM platform, empowering companies of every size and industry to connect with their customers in a whole new way. We believe in doing business as the greatest platform for change — and that starts with our people. At Salesforce, we're committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Technical Support Engineer – Proactive Monitoring to join our growing Technical Support Engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring platform health and customer success by proactively identifying, analyzing, and addressing potential issues before they impact our customers.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about technology, loves solving complex problems, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
The ProM team runs 24x7x365 .
  
  
Candidates must be flexible to work on different Shifts including APAC/EMEA/AMER hours as and when required. Must be available to work on a few weekends and Holidays as part of the business need.
  
  
**What You'll Do
  
  
Proactive Monitoring: Continuously monitor Salesforce platform health dashboards, alerts, and telemetry signals to detect anomalies and potential issues before they escalate into customer-impacting incidents.
  
  
Incident Detection & Triage: Analyze monitoring alerts, log data, and system metrics to identify root causes and escalate findings to the appropriate engineering or operations teams.
  
  
Customer-Centric Outreach: Proactively engage with customers affected by identified issues, providing timely communication and resolution guidance to minimize disruption.
  
  
Case Management: Create, manage, and resolve support cases with thorough documentation of findings, actions taken, and resolutions.
  
  
Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Operations, and senior Technical Support Engineers to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement.
  
  
Knowledge Base Contribution: Document troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and best practices to enhance the team's collective knowledge and improve future response times.
  
  
Tooling & Automation: Leverage internal monitoring tools, dashboards, and scripting to streamline alert management and reduce manual effort.
  
  
Trend Analysis: Identify recurring patterns or systemic issues from monitoring data and escalate insights to engineering teams for long-term fixes.**
**What We're Looking For
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
  
6–24 months of experience in technical support, IT operations, systems monitoring, or a related role.
  
  
Solid understanding of cloud computing concepts, SaaS platforms, and web technologies (HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, DNS, SSL/TLS).
  
  
Basic familiarity with monitoring tools and concepts (e.g., log analysis, alerting, dashboards).
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguous situations.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
A genuine passion for customer success and a customer-first mindset.
  
  
Salesforce Admin Experience: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Administration — including user management, profiles, roles, permission sets, flows, validation rules, and basic configuration of Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
  
  
Salesforce Developer Experience: Working knowledge of Salesforce development fundamentals — including Apex (triggers, classes), Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL queries, and basic understanding of the Salesforce data model and deployment processes (Change Sets / Salesforce DX).
  
  
Ability to read and interpret debug logs, error messages, and system exceptions within the Salesforce platform to assist in root cause analysis and proactive issue identification.**
**Preferred Qualifications**
Familiarity with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform, etc.) or prior experience using/supporting CRM platforms.
  
  
Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
  
  
Basic scripting or automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar).
  
  
Understanding of ITIL frameworks or incident management best practices.
  
  
Salesforce Administrator or Developer certification is a plus.
  
  
Experience working in an Agile or DevOps environment.

title: Customer Support Analyst II (VM)
description:
**General Summary**
Responsible for providing effective customer and service support to the GHX user community. Primarily responsible for providing professional, courteous, and efficient support for GHX customers according to established procedures and application of critical thinking and GHX solution expertise. Position requires a commitment to improving the customer experience by working collaboratively with GHX teammates and customers to drive efficient medical supply chain operations
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Serves as a primary point of contact for GHX customers communication via phone, email, and Chat.
* Resolves GHX Support and product issues by participating in inbound Support request triage, routing and resolution as needed.
* Works directly with Supplier customers and GHX teammates to understand and resolve issues and interaction patterns completely.
* Provides analysis of customer interactions, tracks and maintain logs of customer concerns and resolutions within the designated Salesforce application. Participates in solution development and enhancement to improve the customer experience.
* Seeks to understand the needs of GHX customers to best resolve issues through the application of standard solutions and enhancement of existing systems and processes.
* Engages Problem Management and Product teams and processes to identify system and product deficiencies, including potential enhancements that will directly or indirectly improve the customer experience.
* Uses GHX knowledgebase articles, training sessions and other available resources to develop a functional understanding of GHX products and services to resolve customers issues and drive utilization.
* Meet or exceed productivity and performance measures for the position as defined.
* Monitor and respond to customer cases, system alerts or other service management related notifications within response time goals.
* Other responsibilities, as assigned.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Demonstrate effective troubleshooting skills to identify root cause to provide accurate solution and inform prevention of repeat occurrences.
* Ability to balance multiple work tasks at the same time and deliver solutions in a timely manner with quality.
* Self-organization and time management skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
* Customer service and interpersonal skills
* Growth mentality that embraces change and owns personal contribution to success.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
* Must have the ability to follow verbal and written communications and communicate effectively with customers and coworkers in a professional and courteous manner.
* Must be able to explain, follow and enforce operating policies and procedures as appropriate.
* Must have the ability to grasp technical concepts with accuracy.
* Must have 2+ years of experience in customer support and international calling.

**Additional Information**

* Must be a Graduate
* Flexible to work US shifts (Rotational)
* Work from the office
* Transportation - 1-way provided (Drop cab)
* Immediate Joiners only

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
  
  
GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
  
  
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II- Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
The Global Technology Services (GTS) organization delivers technology products and services that support Deloitte professionals across the enterprise. Within GTS, the Cloud Operations team helps design, automate, monitor, and manage cloud infrastructure across major cloud service providers to improve consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role supports cloud platform operations and automation efforts across Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtual desktop infrastructure environments. The Infrastructure Engineer II will work across engineering and support teams to help enable stable, scalable, and automated cloud operations.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an
**Infrastructure Engineer II**
on the
**Cloud Operations**
team, you will be responsible for supporting cloud infrastructure operations, automation, monitoring, and issue resolution across enterprise platforms.
  
  

* Support the development, maintenance, and operational administration of cloud-based infrastructure and technology solutions.
* Troubleshoot incidents and service requests across Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtual desktop infrastructure environments, including AWS WorkSpaces.
* Assist with automation, configuration management, and deployment activities using cloud-native tools, scripting, and platform services.
* Participate in incident response, operational support, documentation, and Agile team ceremonies to help maintain service continuity and delivery quality.
* Collaborate with cloud platform, development, quality assurance, support, and operations teams to support end-to-end application and infrastructure lifecycle management.

**The team**
The Cloud Operations team is part of Global Technology Services (GTS) and supports Deloitte’s enterprise cloud environment across multiple platforms. The team focuses on infrastructure consistency, automation, monitoring, and operational support to help deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud services. Team members work closely with engineering, development, and support stakeholders to improve cloud operations and enable efficient service delivery.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a comparable technical field
* 3-6 years of experience in information technology, cloud operations, infrastructure engineering, or systems support
* Experience supporting services across Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Experience with cloud identity, networking, compute, storage, load balancing, policy, or recovery services, including examples such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Functions, and Service Accounts
* Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure, including AWS WorkSpaces
* Experience using ServiceNow for incident or request management
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring, alert handling, or production support across cloud environments

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with automation or scripting using Azure DevOps, PowerShell, or Python
* Experience with DevOps, configuration management, or continuous integration tools and practices
* Experience working in Agile delivery models such as Scrum, Kanban, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), or Extreme Programming (XP)
* Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator, AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments
* Exposure to application programming interface (API) architecture, API management, MuleSoft, Prisma Cloud, or Epsagon

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: AMS Cloud EPM FCCS Consultant
description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6+ years of relevant professional experience.
  
While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
  
  
The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) support team providing end-to-end support for Oracle EPM FCCS (Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud Service). The role involves handling functional and technical support tickets related to financial consolidation processes and ensuring smooth monthly close operations.
  
  
- Provide L2/L3 support for financial consolidation applications such as HFM / FCCS, ensuring timely resolution of production issues and service requests.
  
- Support financial close cycle activities, including consolidation, intercompany eliminations, currency translations, and reporting.
  
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data loads, metadata, business rules, calculation scripts, reports, and security configurations.
  
- Monitor and support FDM / FDMEE / Data Management loads, ensuring accurate and timely data integration.
  
- Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement permanent fixes or workarounds.
  
- Assist in data reconciliation, validation, and tie-outs across financial systems and reports.
  
- Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes for finance users.
  
- Handle incident management, service requests, and enhancement of tickets within defined SLA timelines.
  
- Support user access management, security roles, and application maintenance activities.
  
- Coordinate with technical teams for issue resolution, minor enhancements, and system changes.
  
- Maintain documentation, support logs, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues and solutions.
  
- Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, change management) in AMS operations.
  
- Work closely with business users to understand issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner.
  
- Support deployment validation and post-production stabilization activities when required.
  
- Participate in shift-based support activities aligned to business requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- 5–10 years of experience in Oracle EPM Cloud / Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) / FCCS support or implementation projects.
  
- Hands-on experience in application support, AMS, or post-go-live support environments.
  
- Exposure FDM / FDMEE / Data Management tools.
  
- Understanding financial close processes including consolidation, elimination, and reporting.
  
- Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS accounting standards, and financial reporting concepts.
  
- Experience supporting intercompany eliminations, currency translations, and ownership structures.
  
- Strong skills in data reconciliation and issue troubleshooting.
  
- Familiarity with audit controls, SOX compliance, and financial governance processes.
  
- Exposure to additional EPM Cloud modules such as ARCS or Narrative Reporting (EPRCS) is a plus.
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  
- Ability to work independently in a client-facing support environment.
  
- Alignment with delivery values: Can-Do attitude, teamwork, ownership, and client focus.
  
- Willingness to work in a shift-based support model as required.
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Everyone knows technology is the fastest changing industry in the world. We’re shaping our IT landscape by transforming how we deliver our IT change projects, and we need you to join us. You’ll build collaborative relationships in a team that brings together extremely talented individuals who have enjoyed long careers at Deloitte and many new people like you. Join them at this exciting time and you will be enjoying the kind of professional development where you can explore your potential.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Active Directory AM on the Active Directory Services (ADS), you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Administering and maintaining Active Directory (AD) services, including domain controllers, Group Policy objects, directory topology, replication, Global Catalog servers, security configuration, and schema changes.
* Managing account lifecycle activities for user, service, generic, and vendor accounts through Active Directory and Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), including onboarding, transfers, and offboarding.
* Supporting and troubleshooting internal and external Domain Name System (DNS) services, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) architecture and scopes, Kerberos, Windows authentication, authorization, and directory-service standards.
* Resolving AD incidents, service requests, break-fix issues, and recurring problems; creating and maintaining technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge-base articles, and operational runbooks.
* Developing and testing disaster recovery procedures for AD, DNS, MIM, and Network Policy Server (NPS).
* Partnering with infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendors on infrastructure design, supported-version management, major-incident response, and continual service improvement; participating in the ADS on-call rotation outside normal working hours and providing guidance to junior team members.

**The team**
The Active Directory Services (ADS) team supports the enterprise identity and access foundation that enables secure, reliable access to Deloitte systems. The team manages Active Directory, Microsoft Identity Manager, DNS, and related authentication services while partnering with infrastructure and application teams to maintain resilient platforms. Team members collaborate across locations to resolve issues, strengthen operational processes, and support continuous service improvement.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST / 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST during UK daylight saving time**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology.
* 6-8 years of experience in an Active Directory administration role.
* Experience administering Active Directory architecture and infrastructure, including Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), directory replication, restoration, Group Policy, security configuration, and schema changes.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting DNS, DHCP, Kerberos, Windows authentication, and single sign-on integrations.
* Experience managing account lifecycle processes with Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), including user, service, generic, and vendor accounts.
* Experience resolving Active Directory incidents, service requests, break-fix issues, and recurring problems using documented incident-management processes.
* Experience working within Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) incident, change, and problem management processes.

Preferred:
  
  

* ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.
* Microsoft AZ-800: Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure certification.
* Experience using Remote Server Administration Tools, Active Directory Users and Computers (ADUC), Group Policy Management Console (GPMC), PowerShell, ServiceNow, Varonis, System Center Operations Manager (SCOM), or SolarWinds.
* Experience developing and testing disaster recovery procedures for Active Directory, DNS, MIM, and NPS.
* Experience supervising and coaching junior Active Directory support staff.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
