Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Title:
  
  
**Safety Reporting Business Application Specialist - Hyderabad**
Position Summary
  
  
The main purpose of the Safety Reporting Business Application Specialist position is:
  
  
To provide operational pharmacovigilance expertise and business systems support for global safety reporting activities and systems. The role will combine a strong understanding of day-to-day safety reporting requirements with the systems knowledge needed to support Global Safety Reporting leadership and activities across the safety reporting software development lifecycle. The role will act as a bridge between safety reporting business users, the Business Application Owner, development teams, and external vendors. It will translate regulatory and operational needs into clear business and functional requirements for system configuration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities May Include**

* Providing hands-on technical and operational support for safety reporting systems, interfaces, data flows, and automated processes.
* Supporting the Safety Reporting Manager/Associate Director with system development, maintenance, Level 3 incident investigation, enhancements, validation, and SDLC documentation
* Contributing to the design, configuration, testing, implementation, and post-deployment support of Safety Reporting system changes.
* Understanding complex database integrations, interface logic, coding concepts, data mappings, and system dependencies.
* Translating safety reporting business needs and regulatory requirements into business and functional solutions.
* Supporting compliant and timely distribution of SUSARs, SUSAR Line Listings, and Development Safety Update Reports.

Major Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
Major responsibilities are listed in order of approximate percentage of time. The percentages may vary according to project and operational priorities.
  
  
Tasks / Duties / Responsibilities
  
  
**Safety Reporting Operations & Business Analysis - 55%**

* Provide subject matter expertise for global safety reporting activities, including SUSARs, SUSAR Line Listings, and Development Safety Update Reports, and ensure system solutions support timely and accurate distribution to investigators, Independent Ethics Committees, and Institutional Review Boards in line with applicable requirements.
* Interpret business processes, regulatory requirements, reporting rules, and user needs and translate them into functional and non-functional requirements, process flows, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, data requirements, and impact assessments.
* Assess whether proposed technical solutions meet safety reporting business, regulatory, data integrity, security, and operational continuity needs.
* Design and execute user acceptance testing, document results, manage defects, and support traceability from requirements through implementation.
* Act as a key link between Global Safety Reporting users, Information Technology, system developers, vendors, and other stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics in clear business language and explaining business requirements to technical teams.
* Identify opportunities for automation, control improvements, simplification, and improved user experience without compromising compliance.

**Business Application Support & System Lifecycle Management - 35%**

* Support the Safety Reporting Manager/Associate Director in the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvement of safety reporting applications throughout their lifecycle.
* Analyze system architecture, interfaces, data flows, business rules, and dependencies to assess operational impact and support business decisions. Work with technical teams to investigate incidents, identify root causes, assess business impact, and define sustainable corrective solutions.
* Review proposed system designs, interfaces, and configurations from a business and compliance perspective.
* Support data queries, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and technical analysis using appropriate database and reporting tools.
* Contribute to the design, configuration, testing, validation, release readiness, deployment, and post-deployment support of safety reporting system changes.

Maintain clear business and functional documentation to support system reliability, knowledge transfer within Global Safety Reporting, audit readiness, and business continuity.
  
  
10%
  
  
**Quality, Documentation & Training - 10%**

* Support controlled documentation, including procedures, work instructions, system lifecycle documentation, validation records, training materials, and support guides.
* Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable quality standards, departmental procedures, and system lifecycle requirements.
* Provide audit and inspection support by supplying accurate system, process, testing, and issue-management evidence.
* Deliver business process and system-use training
* Deliver technical and process training to users and provide ongoing guidance following system changes or implementation.
* Maintain current knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations, safety reporting practices, safety reporting systems, data flows, integration concepts, and relevant business tools, database technologies, system integration methods, and relevant technical tools.

Perform other duties that are consistent with the role and may be assigned according to business, regulatory, operational, or project needs.
  
  
**Key Working Relationships**
Internal
  
  
Global Safety Reporting, Global Case Management, Global Development, Information Technology, Quality, Data Privacy, Information Security, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory, and other system or process stakeholders.
  
  
External
  
  
eSUSAR distribution system vendor, outsourcing vendor teams, software developers, technical support teams, implementation partners, and other service providers.
  
  
Decision Making Authority
  
  
**Decision Making Authority**

* Trains employees and system users within the scope of assigned responsibilities.
* Recommends technical and process solutions based on documented business, regulatory, quality, and system requirements.
* Escalates system, data, compliance, and delivery risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Does not make hiring, pay, promotion, termination, grievance, or budget decisions.

**Required Qualifications**
**Required Minimum Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, computer science, information systems, engineering, data science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**
Previous pharmaceutical industry, clinical, pharmacovigilance, or safety systems experience, typically demonstrated by a minimum of 8+ years of relevant experience. Experience must include practical knowledge of safety reporting operations and involvement in technical system support, system implementation, database integration, or business analysis.
  
  
**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
**Pharmacovigilance & Regulatory Expertise**

* Strong working knowledge of pharmacovigilance operations and global safety reporting, including individual case safety reports, SUSARs, SUSAR Line Listings, and Development Safety Update Reports.
* Ability to understand reporting requirements, operational controls, data quality expectations, and the compliance impact of system changes or failures.
* Experience working in a regulated environment and supporting inspection-ready processes and documentation.

**Business Applications, Systems & Data.**

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex databases, application architecture, interfaces, integrations, data models, data mappings, business rules, and automated workflows sufficiently to assess business and operational impact.
* Ability to review and discuss system designs, interface specifications, and configuration proposals with technical teams
* Practical experience with database querying, preferably SQL, and the ability to analyze data, investigate discrepancies, and support reconciliation activities.
* Understanding of application programming interfaces, structured data exchange, system-to-system integrations, and common integration failure points.
* Experience supporting system incidents, root-cause analysis, change control, releases, upgrades, testing, validation, and defect management.

**Business Analysis & Communication**

* Demonstrated ability to convert business and regulatory needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and communicate business context precisely to technical teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and improved user experience without compromising compliance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work with global cross-functional teams, and operate effectively across ongoing system lifecycle and operational support activities.le Requirements

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Minimum Education:**
Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant life science or technical discipline.
  
  
**Preferred Area Of Study**
Life sciences, pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, computer science, information systems, engineering, data science, or a related field.
  
  
**Preferred Related Industry Experience**
Experience with pharmacovigilance technology platforms, eSUSAR distribution systems, regulated system implementation, data migration, or digital transformation projects.
  
  
**Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
Hands-on experience with SQL or another query language; application programming interfaces; structured data formats; integration or middleware platforms; cloud-based applications; reporting or analytics tools; Agile delivery; and regulated system lifecycle or validation practices.
  
  
Key Working Relationships
  
  
**Travel On The Job**
Yes

**Type of Travel Required:**
Domestic and international, as needed

No

N/A

Direct reports: 0; Indirect reports: 0

**Preferred Skills:**
Clinical Operations, Coaching, Critical Thinking, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Health Intelligence, Performance Measurement, Pharmacovigilance, Process Optimization, Quality Control (QC), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Affairs Management, Report Writing, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Safety Investigations, Safety-Oriented, Serious Adverse Event Reporting, Technologically Savvy

title: Success Architect
description:
**Description**
**Success Architect**
**Role Description**
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.
  
  
Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long-term success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:**

* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate & Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.

**Basic Requirements**
Solution Design & Architecture
  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on technical experience (e.g., Senior Support Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Senior Salesforce Admin).
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
* Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
* Familiarity with industry- or vertical-specific solutions (preferred).

Communication & Leadership
  
  

* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage customer-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
* High proficiency in English.

Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
  
  

* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Desired Technical Skills

Sales Cloud Expertise
  
  

* Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
* Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.

Data Management & Integration
  
  

* Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
* Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third-party connectors.

Secure & Scalable Architecture
  
  

* Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
* Ability to review a customer's security model for common issues.
* Skilled in identifying common anti-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.

Salesforce Development
  
  

* Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Hands-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

The administrator serves as the primary steward for ServiceNow user provisioning and role management, ensuring users are not over-provisioned, elevated licenses are controlled, and access aligns with the principle of least privilege. SendClean
  
  
An Email Platform by Route Mobile Limited
  
  

* Proximus Group

**Email Deliverability Engineer**
Location Hyderabad, India (on-site)
  
  
Function Email Deliverability & Platform Operations
  
  
Experience 4–7 years in email deliverability / MTA operations
  
  
Type Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Route Mobile Limited is a publicly listed Cloud Communications (CPaaS) provider, in the business since
  
  
2004, serving enterprises, OTT players and mobile operators across BFSI, retail, travel and e-commerce.
  
  
SendClean is our high-volume email platform.
  
  
SendClean is Route Mobile’s high-volume email platform. We push billions of transactional and
  
  
marketing emails a month for banks, fintechs, retail and OTT customers across India, LATAM, the
  
  
Middle East and now the US market. At that scale, deliverability is not a marketing checkbox – it is an
  
  
engineering problem. Every point of inbox placement we lose is revenue our customers lose.
  
  
We are looking for a Deliverability Engineer who can live in both worlds: someone who understands
  
  
sender reputation, ISP policy and authentication as deeply as any deliverability consultant, but who is
  
  
also comfortable on a Linux box at 2 AM reading MTA logs to find out why a sending IP suddenly started
  
  
getting 421s from Google. If you can read a bounce log, tell the difference between a real block and a
  
  
transient defer, and explain to a customer why their list quality is killing their reputation – in the same
  
  
afternoon – you are the person we want.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will own inbox placement for a large book of enterprise senders, work
  
  
directly with the SRE and platform teams on the sending infrastructure, and be the person the delivery
  
  
team escalates to when something is genuinely on fire.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Do**
– Own deliverability end-to-end. Own inbox placement and sender reputation across our sending IP
  
  
pools and domains – monitor it, defend it, and recover it when it drops.
  
  
– Debug on the server. Read the logs. Dig through MTA logs (receiving and sending nodes), SMTP
  
  
transaction logs and bounce data to root-cause why mail is deferring, bouncing or landing in spam.
  
  
You should be able to tell a 4xx defer from a 5xx block and know what to do about each.
  
  
– Warm-up & IP hygiene. Manage IP warm-up schedules for new ranges and new customers, and
  
  
know when to slow a sender down before they burn a range.
  
  
– Authentication. Set up and read SPF, DKIM, DMARC (and BIMI where it applies). Diagnose
  
  
alignment failures and fix authentication issues for customers who bring their own domains.
  
  
– ISP & mailbox provider policy. Stay ahead of Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft sender requirements
  
  
and enforcement changes, and translate them into concrete actions before they hit our customers –
  
  
not after.
  
  
– Blocklist monitoring & remediation. Watch Spamhaus, SURBL, Barracuda and the other
  
  
blocklists. When we get listed, you find out why, fix the root cause, and drive the delisting.
  
  
– Bounce & complaint handling. Classify and act on bounces and FBL/complaint feedback, keep
  
  
suppression clean, and use complaint and bounce signatures to catch list-quality and spamtrap
  
  
problems early.
  
  
– Metrics & reporting. Build and read dashboards (Kibana / Grafana or similar) for delivery, bounce
  
  
and latency metrics. Turn raw delivery data into something a customer or an account manager can
  
  
act on.
  
  
– Customer-facing deliverability. Work directly with customers on their sending practices – list
  
  
hygiene, content, cadence, authentication – and hold the line on our compliance and anti-abuse
  
  
standards.
  
  
– Cross-team work. Partner with SRE, platform and support engineering on MTA config, queue
  
  
behaviour and infrastructure changes that affect delivery. Deliverability doesn’t happen in isolation
  
  
from the platform.
  
  
– Audits & compliance. Run regular audits of our sending infrastructure and practices against
  
  
industry standards and mailbox-provider requirements, and keep us compliant with anti-spam
  
  
regulation (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL and the rest).
  
  
– Vendor & postmaster relationships. Own the external relationships that decide our fate – blocklist
  
  
operators, feedback-loop and seed-list / inbox-placement providers, and mailbox-provider
  
  
postmaster channels – to troubleshoot issues and push delistings through.
  
  
– Documentation. Keep deliverability SOPs, runbooks and playbooks current so the delivery and
  
  
support teams can handle the routine cases without escalating every time.
  
  
– Mentoring & training. Coach the delivery and support teams on deliverability fundamentals – turn
  
  
tribal knowledge into something the whole team can actually use.

 Role Statement
   

  

 The ERP Second Level Support (RUN) Senior Analyst is accountable for ensuring advanced functional support and deep root\-cause analysis for complex issues escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, acting as the subject\-matter expert for a specific Oracle EBS module.
   

  

 This role contributes to stable operations by driving effective resolution, implementing preventive measures, and supporting continuous improvement of Oracle EBS processes. The Senior Analyst takes end\-to\-end ownership of complex tickets, designs and validates functional fixes and workarounds, and ensures structured ticket handover within the Follow\-the\-Sun model to deliver uninterrupted support coverage.

title: System Engineer
description:
**Role: Cloud Engineer, Systems** 




**Windows or Linux Server Engineering in the Cloud** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 We are moving customer workloads into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and running them on a managed services platform built as code. As a Cloud Engineer, Systems, you are the server expert on the team: you build, migrate, and support customer Windows or Linux servers using the platform automation, and you extend that automation for operating system tasks. You will also provide Tier 2 support for customer environments already in production.
 



 We are hiring for both Windows\-focused and Linux\-focused engineers under this role. The focus is server and cloud infrastructure engineering. Deep expertise in Oracle applications or databases is not required.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Server Build and Configuration
 


* Deploy customer servers through the team's OpenTofu modules, Ansible playbooks, and CI/CD pipelines, and extend them when a build needs something new.
* Configure, harden, and patch Windows or Linux servers to platform standards using Ansible, including monitoring, backup, and security agents.
* Handle directory integration, DNS, storage, and application prerequisites at the operating system level.



 Migrations
 


* Set up and monitor workload replication, execute cutovers, and run post\-cutover checks from documented runbooks.
* Fix operating system issues after migration: boot, drivers, networking, licensing and activation, and performance.
* Handle older and end\-of\-life operating systems, recommending the safest path to migrate or upgrade them.



 Customer Environment Support
 


* Provide Tier 2 support for running customer environments: troubleshoot incidents, fulfill service requests, and execute changes following change management processes.
* Perform backup restores and take part in disaster recovery tests.
* Escalate complex issues to the Cloud Architect with clear findings and next steps.



 Automation and Documentation
 


* Write Python, PowerShell, or Bash automation for repeatable operating system tasks, delivered through GitHub pull requests.
* Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles for the servers you build and support, so Tier 1 engineers can operate them without escalating.
* Work second shift with overlap for handoffs to the US team, and join the on\-call rotation after onboarding.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* 4\+ years in systems administration or engineering, including 2\+ years supporting servers in a major public cloud (OCI, Azure, or AWS).
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in either Windows Server or Linux, with working knowledge of the other.
* Windows focus: Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP, Group Policy, IIS, patching, and performance troubleshooting.
* Linux focus: Oracle Linux, RHEL, or Ubuntu administration, systemd, LVM and file systems, package management, SELinux, patching, and performance troubleshooting.
* Scripting for automation: Python, plus PowerShell for Windows or Bash for Linux.
* Working knowledge of Terraform or OpenTofu: reading, running, and extending existing modules.
* Ansible: writing and maintaining playbooks and roles for Windows or Linux configuration (or strong experience with a comparable tool such as Chef, Puppet, or PowerShell DSC).
* Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests, and code review.
* Core cloud services in at least one major cloud: compute, block storage, virtual networking, and identity and access management.
* Experience supporting production environments: incident troubleshooting, service requests, and change execution.
* Lifelong learner: self\-driven to research, study documentation and training videos, and figure out unfamiliar technologies on the fly.
* Sound judgment in handling customer data securely and working within compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001\.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable documenting work and collaborating with US\-based team members.



  





**Preferred Skills and Experience** 



* OCI hands\-on experience (strongly preferred). Candidates with strong Azure or AWS backgrounds who are ready to ramp on OCI are encouraged to apply.
* Server migration into public cloud, using tools such as OCI Cloud Migrations, RackWare, Azure Migrate, or AWS Application Migration Service.
* Image and bootstrap tooling such as Packer or cloud\-init.
* Backup and disaster recovery tooling (OCI Full Stack DR, Azure Site Recovery, or similar).
* Hands\-on experience across more than one public cloud.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Managed\-services or MSP experience.
* Certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft AZ\-800/AZ\-801, AZ\-104, OCI Architect Associate, or equivalent.

title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
   

  

**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology \& Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
 Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
 **Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications** 
 . The role combines hands\-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major\-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient\-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on\-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
   

  

**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**
* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.


**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Service Operations Leadership**
* Lead day\-to\-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.


**2\. Clinical Workflow \& Application Support**
* Support end\-to\-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order\-to\-result processes, medication\-management workflows, imaging order\-to\-report processes and associated ancillary\-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow\-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient\-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.


**3\. Integrations, Interfaces \& Data Exchange**
* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.


**4\. Incident, Major Incident \& Problem Management**
* Own or coordinate high\-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.


**5\. Change, Release \& Environment Management**
* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post\-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production\-readiness checks across on\-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change\-management controls.


**6\. Monitoring, Reliability \& Continual Improvement**
* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early\-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self\-service, standardisation and knowledge\-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.


**7\. Team Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross\-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross\-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge\-base articles, known\-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business\-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross\-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL\-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on\-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross\-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical\-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service\-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster\-recovery exercises or major clinical go\-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.


**Core Competencies**
**Technical \& Domain**
**Operational Leadership**
**Ways of Working**
* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on\-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major\-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk\-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation
* Clear executive communication
* Knowledge sharing and collaboration


**Success Measures**
* Service availability, SLA achievement and timely restoration of clinically significant incidents.
* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.
* Quality and completion of root cause, corrective action, change validation and operational\-readiness activities.
* Improved monitoring coverage, documentation quality, automation adoption and cross\-training readiness.
* Stakeholder confidence in service ownership, communication and operational follow\-through.


**Note:** 
 The 8\-12 year experience range is recommended to reflect the expanded lead\-level scope and should be aligned with the organisation's approved job architecture before publication. Product\-specific requirements may be added based on the final application portfolio.

**Integrations \& Ecosystem Support**

**Qualifications**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Junior RPA, Automation \& AI Analyst is an entry\-level role supporting the delivery of process automation and operational efficiency initiatives within the ERP Tech Factory. Under the guidance of a Senior Analyst or the ERP Tech Factory Lead, this role contributes to the design, development, and deployment of RPA \& automation solutions and AI\-powered tools.

It serves as the foundational entry point into the RPA \& Automation discipline, providing exposure to enterprise\-scale automation, AI\-powered tooling, and structured development practices.

* Support the configuration and testing of AI\-powered tools, ensuring solutions are functional, reliable, and aligned with defined requirements.
* Participate in technical reviews and testing cycles, providing input on solution quality and flagging issues for senior review and resolution.


**Asset Maintenance \& Documentation**
* Maintain and update reusable automation and AI solution assets, ensuring they remain accurate, functional, and consistent with the latest platform and process requirements.
* Document developed solutions, workflows, and operational procedures to support knowledge retention, team onboarding, and future maintainability.
* Follow established development frameworks, naming conventions, and version control practices to ensure all deliverables meet team quality standards.
* Support incident resolution for assigned automation solutions by performing root\-cause analysis and implementing fixes under senior supervision.


**Process Analysis Support**
* Support the identification of automation and AI use case opportunities by analyzing process inefficiencies, repetitive manual tasks, and error\-prone workflows.
* Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements, process flows, and use case specifications required for automation scoping and development.
* Contribute to the preparation of business case materials by collecting data on manual effort, processing volumes, and anticipated automation benefits.
* Translate business process knowledge into automation\-ready specifications, supporting the pipeline from opportunity identification through to development handover.


**Collaboration \& Learning**
* Work closely with ERP Second Level Support, Third\-Level Support Engineers, and Software Development/Platform Engineers to understand system context, data flows, and integration dependencies relevant to assigned automation tasks.
* Actively participate in team meetings, technical reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions, contributing observations and lessons learned from assigned deliverables.
* Pursue continuous learning in RPA platforms, AI tooling, and development practices, including relevant certifications (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate) to build technical depth.
* Coordinate submission of resolved issues, applied fixes, and process documentation to the broader team to support knowledge retention and operational continuity.


**Required**

* Basic experience automating business processes or working with ERP or enterprise platforms, including exposure to data entry, report generation, or workflow automation tasks.
* Foundational knowledge of RPA platform capabilities, AI tool development concepts, and how automation solutions are designed, built, and deployed in enterprise environments.
* Understanding of software development and release practices, including version control, testing principles, and structured delivery workflows (e.g., Agile, Kanban).
* Ability to translate business processes into automation\-ready specifications with clear steps, inputs, outputs, and exception\-handling requirements.
* Collaborative mindset with a strong sense of accountability for assigned deliverables, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn and grow within a structured technical team.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to Oracle EBS or similar ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics), particularly in the context of process automation or data operations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira Cloud for task tracking, incident management, or agile delivery workflows.
* Relevant certifications or training in RPA platforms, such as UiPath Foundation, Microsoft Power Automate Fundamentals, or equivalent, demonstrating a commitment to professional development.
* Background or academic exposure in computer science, information systems, business process management, or a related technical discipline.

* Task completion rate and quality (% of assigned automation tasks delivered on time and meeting defined acceptance criteria)
* Automation execution success rate (% of bot runs completing without error for solutions under ownership)

description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms \& Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
   

  

 You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof\-of\-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora\-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
   

  

 Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte\-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

 Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
   

  

 Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
   

  

 Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
   

  

 Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 \& s3\)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL \& ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

* Network Troubleshooting
* Incident Management
* Customer Focus
* Critical Thinking
* Root Cause Analysis
* Technical Communication
* Collaboration \& Teamwork
* Operational Excellence

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
 As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.
   

  

 A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions\-oriented are critical for this position.
   

  

**This Role Is For You If**
* You have an in\-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross\-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business\-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.


 At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast\-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results\-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.
   

  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third\-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform\-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast\-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time\-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self\-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.


**The Accurate Way**
 We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
   

  

**Take ownership.**
 Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
   

  

**Be open.**
 Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
   

  

**Stay curious.**
 Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
   

  

**Work as one.**
 Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
   

  

**Special Notice**
 Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
   

  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in\-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

title: Workforce Software consultant II
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Senior Analyst focuses specifically on the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's Workforce Software (WFM) system. They bridge the gap between IT and Operations, ensuring the software accurately models business rules and delivers actionable data for scheduling, capturing, forecasting, and calculating time data for payroll processes..
   

  

 The Workforce Software Senior Analyst is the subject matter expert responsible for the technical administration, configuration, and data integrity of the Workforce Software (WFM) system. This role ensures the WFM platform accurately reflects business logic, supports efficient staffing and scheduling, and provides reliable data for operational and financial analysis.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* WFM System Administration \& Configuration: Maintain and update core WFM system settings, policy profiles, employee profiles, time\-off policies, quota calculations and timesheet calculations.
* Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy of data integrations between the WFM system and upstream HR/Payroll systems (e.g., SAP Employee Central Payroll). Troubleshoot and resolve data flow errors.
* User Management: Manage user access, roles, and permissions within the WFM application.
* System Upgrades \& Testing: Participate in testing and validation for WFM system upgrades, patches, and feature rollouts to ensure seamless performance and compliance.
* Optimization \& Analysis: Monitor jobs for review and correction of errors.
* Rule Engine Optimization: Analyze current scheduling models and configuration settings to identify opportunities for improved forecasting accuracy, adherence, and efficiency.
* Business Requirements: Translate complex business requirements (e.g., new labor agreements, regulatory changes) into functional specifications and configure them within the WFM platform.
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Develop, modify, and manage custom reports and dashboards within the WFM system to provide operational leaders with visibility into key metrics (e.g., compliance, productivity, utilization).
* Support \& Collaboration: Problem resolution with business partners, SAP/WFS, support contractors, and internal IT staff.
* Technical Support: Serve as the Tier 2 or Tier 3 technical contact for WFM system issues, diagnosing problems related to the mobile app and WorkforceHub, integration with SuccessFactors, quota calculations, and timesheet calculations.
* Training \& Documentation: Create and deliver training materials and support documentation for end\-users, WFM schedulers, and new administrators.
* Cross\-Functional Liaison: Collaborate closely with IT, HRIS, Payroll, and Operations teams to ensure system alignment with organizational policies and technical infrastructure.


**Qualifications**
* Any Graduate
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting a major Workforce Software platform.
* Workforce Time Level 1 \- Configuration Specialist
* Workforce Time Level 2 \- Configuration Specialist
* Strong technical aptitude for system logic, relational databases, and data interfaces.
* Experience with SAP Employee Central integration data points with WFM.
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel for data analysis and validation.
* Preferred Skills : Knowledge of time and attendance, payroll processing, and labor law compliance as it relates to system configuration.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Certifications from WorkForce Software permitting system modifications and report creation.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

They will also identify and proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through to complete resolution.

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **End User Training (EUT) Consultant** 
 is a client\-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
   

  

 The EUT Consultant combines
 **instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills** 
 to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role\-based learning experiences.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role\-based training analysis.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into learning objectives and role\-based learning requirements.
* Support development of training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules.
* Design and develop instructor\-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance\-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices.
* Apply foundational Organizational Change Management principles to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, workshops, knowledge\-transfer, and customer enablement sessions.
* Facilitate interactive and hands\-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders.
* Support train\-the\-trainer, super\-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge\-transfer activities.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self\-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future\-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content\-development, quality, version\-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of learning assessments and evaluation approaches and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in end\-user training, Learning \& Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.
* Experience designing and developing training content for enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience delivering instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices.
* Understanding of the relationship between Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end\-user adoption.
* Ability to understand both business\-process and technology concepts and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self\-directed, and customer\-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.
* Experience in supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands\-on learning, knowledge\-transfer, or train\-the\-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means consistently delivering
 **high\-quality, customer\-focused learning experiences** 
 that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.
   

  

 The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.
   

  

 Success is demonstrated through
 **training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality** 
 , while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.
   

  

**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

The role will be executing all aspects of the operating procedures/run books within a predefined shift pattern. * Follow established risk, control, and operational procedures, escalating issues appropriately.
* Collaborate with global teams to ensure consistent support coverage and service delivery.


**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

* Understanding of application support principles, production monitoring, incident management, and troubleshooting.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments, including log analysis and scripting skills
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to execute queries for analysis and tuning activities.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for incident, problem, and change management.
* Familiarity with job scheduling and modern application platforms such as AutoSys, OpenShift, Kubernetes, or cloud\-hosted environments.
* Basic understanding of security fundamentals, including certificate management and credential handling.
* Exposure to capital markets and financial services is preferred.
* Exposure to messaging, networking, or mainframe technologies is a plus.
* Exposure applications hosted in AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Exposure to AI\-powered support tools and automation technologies is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced production support environment and collaborate with globally distributed teams.

 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. title: Operations Engineer
description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward. Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.
   

  

**Who We're Looking For**
 The Operations Engineer provides technical solutions to exceptionally difficult problems. This role will address day\-to\-day customer issues, application issues, problems and concerns that are detailed and complex in nature, requiring analysis and research. This position will install, configure, operate and evolve common infrastructure such as the network, servers, and external services (e.g. the cloud).
   

  

**Some Of What You'll Do**
**Scope of the Role:**
* Direct Reports: This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports


**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide escalated technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status.
* Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third\-party vendors to resolution.
* Identify, analyze and resolve the assigned tickets using root cause analysis to determine the appropriate solution(s).
* Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software.
* Participate in the ticket review process and provide severity and scope analysis of issues, inquiries and requests; maintaining ownership until resolution.
* Analyze metrics and identify the possible reasons for any achievements or deviations.
* Action plan and execute for the feedback received from customers.
* Continuous monitoring of production servers that includes system health, resource utilization, file transfer rate, database insert rate and logs.
* Application health monitoring that includes file processing, data loading, completion of scheduled tasks, report generation, application related processes, dashboards and application logs.
* Use alarm monitoring tools, interpret the condition being alarmed, resolve and/or escalate to the next level support.
* Monitor, execute and support production performance by performing benchmarking and research while initiating actions to improve results and/or problem correction.
* Error research based on the warnings, errors available in the production logs.
* Prioritize the production issues by analyzing the logs, database entries and processes.
* Perform User Acceptance Test in the production environment and perform relevant error research.


**Experience, Education And Certification**

* Good understanding of network protocols and distributed systems.

* Lead day\-to\-day DLP monitoring operations, including queue management, prioritization, SLA tracking, quality review, and escalation oversight.
* Guide Analysts during alert triage, evidence collection, case documentation, and true positive versus false positive validation across email, endpoint, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and cloud activity where applicable.
* Own operational escalation for confirmed, high\-risk, repeat, or sensitive data loss events and coordinate with Insider Risk, Incident Response, DLP Engineering, Legal/Compliance, and business stakeholders as needed.
* Identify recurring false positives, noisy DLP rules, URL filtering policy friction, data classification gaps, and process pain points; translate findings into tuning, policy, and automation recommendations.
