title: Senior Member Technical
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
   

  

 Need to understand, adhere, and execute the process and workflows defined as per production support procedures.
   

  

 Should be willing to work in Night shifts.
   

  

 Need to have strong and should possess L3 working related capabilities in areas of dot net, Informatica and Greenplum. Should have minimum 4\-5 years of working experience in L3 support
   

  

 Should be a quick learner, with decent problem\-solving abilities and is expected to get onto call with client to clarify the issues as needed
   

  

 Should be aware of incident management and problem management procedures which will be helpful in driving incidents.
   

  

 Need to be proactive analyzing and resolving the tickets assigned to the team
   

  

 Take ownership of accepting, acknowledging and handling the incidents as and when raised.
   

  

 Willing to work during weekends as per activities.
   

  

 Shall be well aware of monitoring tools like Splunk, Datadog, etc. to quickly identify and triage the issues
   

  

 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Delivery Analyst
description:
**Req ID:** 
 390645
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Delivery Analyst to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN\-TG), India (IN).
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Application Support \& Maintenance Engineer (L2/L3\) with strong expertise in Adobe ColdFusion, web application support, SQL databases, and production incident management. The candidate will be responsible for providing 24x7 production support, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business\-critical ColdFusion applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess hands\-on experience supporting enterprise applications, resolving production issues, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams to ensure system stability, performance, and availability.
   

  

 The role requires working from the designated ODCs in Noida, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and adhering to the assigned 24x7 shift roster including weekend support.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Application Support \& Incident Management
   

  

 Provide L2/L3 support for Adobe ColdFusion\-based applications in production environments.
   

  

 Monitor application performance, availability, and system health.
   

  

 Analyze and resolve incidents, service requests, and production issues within SLA commitments.
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.
   

  

 Participate in major incident management and bridge calls.
   

  

 Coordinate with developers, database administrators, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders for issue resolution.
   

  

 Support release deployments and post\-deployment validation activities.
   

  

 ColdFusion Application Support
   

  

 Troubleshoot ColdFusion application errors, performance issues, and integration failures.
   

  

 Support ColdFusion services, scheduled tasks, components (CFCs), APIs, and web applications.
   

  

 Analyze application logs, server logs, and error reports to identify issues.
   

  

 Manage ColdFusion server configurations, datasource connectivity, and application settings.
   

  

 Assist development teams in diagnosing complex application defects.
   

  

 Database Support
   

  

 Support Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or similar relational databases.
   

  

 Troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and database performance issues.
   

  

 Execute data corrections and maintenance activities following change management processes.
   

  

 Support backup validation and database\-related application issues.
   

  

 Maintenance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Perform routine application health checks and maintenance activities.
   

  

 Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.
   

  

 Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
   

  

 Participate in application upgrades, patches, and platform modernization initiatives.
   

  

 Recommend system improvements to enhance reliability and performance.
   

  

 Monitoring \& Operations
   

  

 Monitor application services using enterprise monitoring tools.
   

  

 Review alerts, logs, and performance metrics.
   

  

 Ensure timely escalation of critical incidents.
   

  

 Support batch processing, scheduled jobs, and integrations.
   

  

 ITSM \& Compliance
   

  

 Work within Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management processes.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with organizational security and audit requirements.
   

  

 Maintain accurate ticket updates and documentation.
   

  

 Participate in on\-call support and rotational shift schedules as required.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 Primary Skills
   

  

 Adobe ColdFusion (2018/2021/2023 or later)
   

  

 ColdFusion Markup Language (CFML)
   

  

 ColdFusion Components (CFC)
   

  

 ColdFusion Administrator
   

  

 HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
   

  

 REST and SOAP Web Services
   

  

 Database Skills
   

  

 Microsoft SQL Server
   

  

 Oracle Database
   

  

 SQL Query Writing and Optimization
   

  

 Stored Procedures, Functions, Views
   

  

 Operating Systems
   

  

 Windows Server
   

  

 Linux (preferred)
   

  

 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

 IIS / Apache / Web Servers
   

  

 Git / Azure DevOps / SVN
   

  

 ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools
   

  

 Monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Grafana, or SolarWinds
   

  

**Required Experience**
 4 to 10\+ years of IT experience.
   

  

 Minimum 3\+ years supporting Adobe ColdFusion applications.
   

  

 Experience in Application Support \& Maintenance environments.
   

  

 Experience working in ITIL\-based production support organizations.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with incident, problem, and change management processes.
   

  

 Experience supporting customer\-facing web applications.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience supporting cloud\-hosted applications (Azure or AWS).
   

  

 Knowledge of API integrations and middleware interfaces.
   

  

 Experience with application performance tuning.
   

  

 Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD processes.
   

  

 ITIL Foundation certification preferred.
   

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication.
   

  

 Ability to work independently in high\-pressure production environments.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and customer service orientation.
   

  

 Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide on\-call support.
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

 Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.

title: Active Directory Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Active Directory \& Entra Infrastructure Support Engineer** 
 to support and operate our
 **on‑premises and cloud\-based Active Directory environments** 
 , including
 **Azure Entra ID** 
 and associated identity infrastructure.
   

  

 This role is heavily
 **operational in nature** 
 , focused on
 **BAU support, production stability, incident remediation, upgrades, and platform hygiene** 
 , while partnering with security, application, and infrastructure teams.
   

  

 The engineer will play a key role in ensuring
 **availability, security, and performance** 
 of identity services across the enterprise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Active Directory \& Entra Operations**
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for multiple on‑premises and cloud\-based Active Directory environments
* Support and manage Azure Entra ID tenants, hybrid identity setups, and supporting components
* Perform daily operations including user, group, service account, and computer object management
* Implement and manage Delegation Models, Group Policies, and role\-based access controls to meet business requirements
* Support directory integrations with enterprise and third‑party applications


**Infrastructure Maintenance \& Platform Health**
* Own technology currency and upgrades for:
+ AD Domain Controllers
+ Entra / Azure AD components
+ Supporting identity infrastructure

* Perform patching, configuration changes, and infrastructure clean‑up
* Monitor directory health, replication, authentication flows, and system logs
* Conduct regular reviews and audits to ensure stability, compliance, and security posture
* Participate in Disaster Recovery drills, including AD and identity infrastructure restoration


**Incident Management \& Troubleshooting**
* Act as a primary responder for identity‑related production incidents
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues impacting:
+ Authentication
+ Authorization
+ Directory replication
+ Application integrations

* Work closely with application teams, vendors, and platform teams to drive incident resolution
* Support root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action implementation
* Participate in on‑call rotation, including evenings and weekends, as per operational requirements


**Documentation \& Process Support**
* Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides
* Document standard changes, fixes, and known issues
* Support audit requests and internal reviews related to identity platforms
* Continuously improve operational processes and stability


**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience supporting:
+ Microsoft Active Directory
+ Azure / Entra ID
+ Microsoft server infrastructure

* Experience working in enterprise IAM or infrastructure operations teams
* Microsoft certifications (Active Directory, Azure, Identity) are a strong plus


**Technical Skills**
* Strong hands‑on knowledge of:
+ Active Directory architecture, design, and operations
+ Azure Entra ID \& hybrid identity concepts
+ Domain Controllers, trust relationships, DNS, replication

* Experience with:
+ SSO and MFA integrations
+ IAM concepts and access governance
+ PowerShell scripting for automation and support

* Familiarity with:
+ Cloud platforms (Azure primarily; AWS exposure is a plus)
+ Security standards (NIST, ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS)

* Strong troubleshooting skills using Microsoft diagnostic tools

title: GMS-Senior-UAR - IGA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Global Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The IAM Administrator role will be primarily responsible for the support and enhancements that are required for the engagement. Also adhering to stated SLA’s and ensuring high standards of quality deliverables.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Experience in working on any two IAM engagements providing application support (SailPoint IIQ or SailPoint IDN).
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for the system within agreed service levels
* Implement and manage the effectiveness of Incident, Service Request, Change and Problem management processes for the service area
* 3 to 4 years of experience in support, customization, configuration and deployment of any Identity Management and Governance products
* Support IGA tool integration with critical applications and infrastructure
* Assist stakeholder teams as required, coordinate with product engineering team
* Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation.
* Understands of below IGA concepts:
+ User Lifecycle Management, Provisioning, and Reconciliation
+ Auditing, Reporting, and user activity Monitoring
+ Access Certification
+ SOD

* Java/J2EE and knowledge on SQL
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Must be able to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and maintain a positive attitude
* Troubleshoot and maintain user onboarding workflows and role provisioning
* Ability to perform Root Cause Analysis and suggest solutions to avoid errors
* Support onboarding of application and platform users.
* Monitor IAM platform components and resource
* Provide IAM support to end users.
* Work involves day to day health check, incident support (as per defined scope and levels), e\-mail support, tool upgrades and monitoring of systems, reporting the status and working with Development and QA teams to help them fix the issues.
* Should be a good team player to work on a competitive environment
* Must have experience in Application Onboarding
* Experience with IGA integrations, connectors, custom integrations, application patterns, strong technical acumen
* Perform systems analysis and tuning to insure optimal infrastructure response


**Qualifications:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor's Degree required


**Skills Expertise**
* Good soft skills i.e., verbal \& written communication and technical document writing
* Prior experience working in remote teams on global scale
* Customer orientation skills
* Scripting knowledge


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Systems Administrator I
description:
Location:
   

  

 Hyderabad, IN, 500 081
   

  

 Requisition ID: 19686
   

  

 Brightstar is an innovative, forward\-thinking global leader in lottery that builds on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best\-in\-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award\-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, fulfill player needs and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well\-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar has approximately 6,000 employees. For more information, please visit www.brightstarlottery.com.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Installing, managing \& troubleshooting of web layer, middleware software and 3rd party integrations installed on cloud (Azure, AWS) and on\-premises Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu etc..) servers and Windows servers
* Managing Linux servers and windows servers
* Ticket management for system support, including on\-call support
* Troubleshooting detected by monitoring systems
* Documentation management (technical documentation updates)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably BE / B Tech / MCA
* 2\+ years of experience in UNIX / LINUX systems administration


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to work with teams spread across various time zones
* Ability to collaborate effectively in multicultural and geographically distributed environments
* Flexibility and adaptability in supporting both production and development environments


**Tech Skills**
* Enterprise Web Hosting, networking fundamentals, LAMP environments, and web portal technologies (Apache, IIS, CQ5, Tomcat, JBoss)
* Unix/Linux/Windows administration and support across production and development environments
* Oracle/SQL knowledge, including complex query writing and database management (Oracle, DB2, PostgreSQL)
* Scripting and automation using Shell, Python, Perl, Ansible, and Jenkins
* Monitoring, observability, and virtualization technologies (Nagios, ELK, Grafana, Dynatrace, VMware ESX, XEN)
* Cloud and DevOps technologies, including Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, and related certifications


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* Understanding software application integrations, flows, and troubleshooting
* Flexibility, adaptability to change, and availability to support business needs
* Enthusiasm, initiative, determination, reliability, and curiosity for technology
* Ability to drive issues independently and proactively
* Ability to work effectively with teams across different time zones
* Availability to support on\-call duties, incident management, and night maintenance activities


**Success Profile**
* Leading Complexity
* Leading People
* Leading the Business
* Leading Self


 Brightstar is committed to sustaining a workforce that reflects the diversity of the global customers and communities we serve, and to creating a fair and inclusive culture that enables all our employees to feel valued, respected and engaged.  All Brightstar employees have a role in information security. Annual training will be assigned and required as appropriate.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Services Specialist, Firm Risk, Compliance, and Governance Services on the Third Party Risk Management team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Analyzing data in the TPRM Gateway to support reporting, diligence activities, and process monitoring for third parties of Deloitte U.S. Firms

title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands\-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java\-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third\-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large\-volume financial systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
*System Administration \& Environment Management*
* Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers
+ Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
+ Manage multi\-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.

* Apply Oracle\-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.
+ Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
+ Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post\-patch environment integrity.

* Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.
+ Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
+ Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post\-deployment validation.

* Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
* Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment\-specific configuration documentation.


*Development \& Enhancements*
* Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
* Build and maintain third\-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e\-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file\-based patterns.
* Develop and optimize batch programs for high\-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM\-level tuning.
* Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.


*Production Support \& Operations*
* Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
* Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
* Perform year\-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
* Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform\-level issues.


*Collaboration \& Governance*
* Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
* Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
* Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel\-run testing and validation activities.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 5\+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC\&B, including hands\-on administration of OUAF\-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 5\+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi\-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high\-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.


**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**
* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8\.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC\&B / ORMB v2\.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
**Job Title: Customer Service Executive**
 EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.
   

  

 www.eccouncil.org
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The role involves delivering a high\-quality customer experience by understanding customer needs, resolving queries efficiently, and ensuring issues are handled with accuracy and empathy. The position requires strong verbal and written communication, effective problem\-solving, and the ability to take ownership of customer concerns from initial interaction through resolution.
   

  

 The role also involves handling escalations, collaborating with relevant teams when required, adapting to changing processes, and maintaining close attention to detail. A successful candidate should be a quick learner, customer\-focused, accountable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver a positive and consistent customer experience across all interactions.
* Maintain strong CSAT and achieve key service metrics, including response time, resolution time, quality, and productivity.
* Handle all types of customers professionally, including difficult situations and escalations.
* Take ownership and accelerate resolution while ensuring accurate and timely responses.
* Develop strong product and process knowledge to provide effective customer support.
* Ensure error\-free execution and adherence to defined processes and policies.
* Identify recurring issues and report process gaps to help improve the overall customer experience.
* Maintain clear, professional, and effective written and verbal communication.
* Work Schedule: 5\-day working week \| Rotational shifts \& rotational week\-offs


**About Our Culture**
 EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.

title: HRIS Analyst
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HRIS Analyst
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location** 
 : Hyderabad
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3 to 4 Years
   

  

**Joining:** 
 Immediate to 30 Days
   

  

**Shift:** 
 US Shift / Night Shift \- 5PM to 2AM IST
   

  

**Work Model:** 
 4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home.
   

  

**About NationsBenefits:**
 At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back\-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high\-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on
 **platform modernization** 
 — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud\-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core back\-office functions in the insurance domain.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and service\-driven HRIS Analyst to support the ongoing administration and maintenance of our Human Resource Information System, with primary responsibility for UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) Core HR and Workforce Management systems.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring employee data accuracy, processing system updates, managing HRIS tickets, and providing timely support to employees and managers. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on UKG experience and thrive in a structured, high\-volume, SLA\-driven environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 HRIS Administration
   

  

* Serve as system analyst for UKG (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Workforce Management, Recruitment, Onboarding, Document Manager modules).
* Process employee lifecycle transactions include new hires, terminations, transfers, promotions, compensation updates, and organizational changes.
* Maintain system security roles and user access permissions.
* Ensure data accuracy through routine audits and reconciliation activities.
* Support payroll processing by validating employee data prior to payroll deadlines.
* Maintain documentation of processes and standard operating procedures.


 Ticket Management \& Employee Support
   

  

* Manage and resolve HRIS\-related tickets through the company’s ticketing system in accordance with established SLAs.
* Work with IT and other internal and external teams for issue resolution.
* Provide timely, accurate support to employees and managers regarding:
* Employee data updates
* Timekeeping corrections
* Payroll discrepancies
* Benefits elections and life event changes
* System access inquiries
* Document case resolutions and maintain detailed records.
* Escalate complex issues to HRIS Director and coordinate with HR, Payroll, IT, or UKG Support as appropriate.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.


 Data Integrity \& Compliance
   

  

* Perform regular data audits to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
* Reconcile HRIS data with payroll and benefits providers.
* Support internal and external audit requests.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and data privacy standards.


 Reporting Support
   

  

* Generate standard and ad\-hoc reports from UKG to support HR and business leaders.
* Validate data outputs prior to distribution.


**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on HRIS experience.
* Demonstrated experience administering UKG (UKG Pro, UKG Ready).
* Experience working in a ticket\-based support environment.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, including employee lifecycle and payroll processes.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data validation).
* Experience supporting multi\-state or multi\-location workforces.
* Experience with data integrations or file feeds.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High level of accuracy and data integrity
* Customer\-service orientation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline\-driven environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills

description:

 Data Eng, Mgmt. \& Governance – Manager – S\&C Global Network

 7

 Pune/Hyderabad

**Good to have skills:**

 AI Managed Services undertakes Managed Services for variety of AI/ML implementations on all key cloud environments. Machine Learning workloads are built on key ML tools such as Sagemaker, VertexAI, MLflow etc. As a Data Eng, Mgmt. \& Governance – Manager, one understands the importance of sound analytical decision\-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative. This includes effective and efficient delivery of services or products to clients, ensuring they meet service level agreements (SLAs) and customer expectations.

* An opportunity to work on high\-visibility projects with top clients around the globe.
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

* Stakeholder management, guiding \& training them in adhering to ITIL framework and Project Management best practices.
* Act as first level escalation point for business/clients and other teams for any work related to Managed Services
* Lead the offshore support team on day\-to\-day basis, provide guidance in case of questions/concerns by the team
* Contribute to sales process/RFP submission; conduct support workshops for key prospective clients and help in business development of AI Managed Services.

title: TC-CS-IAM-SailPoint-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint IIQ Staff**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 1\-4 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Information Technology Specialist
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 The IT Executive provides on\-site IT support at the Visa Application Centre, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operation of end\-user systems, peripherals, and centre\-facing equipment.
 



 Working under the direction of the central IT team at VAS Headquarters, the role acts as the local on\-ground resource for the centrally managed infrastructure — FortiGate networking with SD\-WAN, biometric devices, access\-control systems, and CCTV — and ensures incidents are diagnosed, escalated, and resolved within defined SLAs while maintaining compliance with VAS security and data\-protection standards.
 



**Roles and Responsibilities** 



1. Provide Level\-1 on\-site IT support to Visa Centre staff under the direction of the central IT team at VAS Headquarters, covering end\-user hardware, software, peripherals, and basic network connectivity issues.
2. Act as on\-site remote hands for the central IT team to power\-cycle, re\-cable, swap, relocate, and label FortiGate firewalls, SD\-WAN edge devices, switches, biometric capture units, passport scanners, access\-control panels, CCTV cameras, and NVRs as instructed.
3. Execute scripted or runbook\-based local tasks, including cabling checks, link tests, status\-LED reporting, equipment photographs, and physical inspections, to support central troubleshooting. Make no independent changes to firewall, SD\-WAN, or network configuration.
4. Monitor visa\-processing systems, appointment portal, biometric workflow, internet and SD\-WAN links at the centre, and report performance or outage issues to the central IT team through the approved ticketing channel within defined SLAs.
5. Maintain the local IT asset inventory at the centre, including tagging, location, serial numbers, condition, and movement, and synchronize updates to the central asset register as agreed.
6. Apply approved end\-user device patches, antivirus checks, and Windows/Office updates pushed by the central team, and confirm completion through the agreed reporting mechanism.
7. Support new\-joiner onboarding at the centre through handover of pre\-configured devices and peripherals, IT acceptable\-use induction, and basic user orientation once accounts and devices are provisioned centrally.
8. Provide first\-line assistance for end\-user issues involving VPN, email, Microsoft 365, biometric capture, and visa\-processing applications, and escalate unresolved incidents to the central IT team with complete diagnostic information.
9. Coordinate with the central IT team for any change, upgrade, or third\-party visit at the centre and act as the on\-site point of contact for ISP technicians, spare\-parts couriers, and authorised vendor engineers.
10. Comply with VAS information\-security, data\-protection, and acceptable\-use policies, and immediately report any incident, suspected breach, unauthorised access, or tampering involving biometric, CCTV, or access\-control equipment.
11. Maintain accurate local records, including ticket logs, change diaries, equipment movement, visitor IT\-access logs, and configuration photographs, and submit them to the central IT team as agreed.
12. Provide on\-the\-ground support during Mission, government, regulator, and internal audits, hardware refreshes, and new technology rollouts driven by the central IT team.



  





**Qualification \& Experience Requirement** 




 Education
 


* Minimum: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.



 Experience
 


* 2–4 years of experience in on\-site IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering, preferably in a multi\-site, branch\-office, or public\-facing service\-centre environment.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive), and common end\-user business applications.
* Working knowledge of LAN/WLAN cabling, switches, Wi\-Fi access points, basic network troubleshooting, and end\-user VPN clients.
* Exposure to FortiGate firewalls and SD\-WAN concepts is preferred.
* Practical experience with peripherals and field equipment, including printers, scanners, biometric capture devices, passport readers, CCTV/NVR systems, and access\-control readers, at support, swap, and replacement level.
* Ability to follow written instructions, runbooks, and remote guidance from a central IT team accurately and document work, observations, and outcomes clearly.
* Strong communication and customer\-service skills, with the ability to support non\-technical end users and external visitors in a high\-traffic, public\-facing centre.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak appointment hours and audit, inspection, or system\-rollout windows.
* Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and extended hours according to the centre operating schedule, and remain reachable on call for centre\-impacting incidents.



  





**Competencies / Personal Attributes** 




  





 Functional Competencies
 


1. End\-User Support \& Helpdesk Operations
2. Site Infrastructure Awareness (FortiGate / SD\-WAN / Biometric / CCTV / Access Control)
3. IT Asset \& Inventory Management
4. SOP Adherence \& Operational Discipline



 Additional Requirements
 


* Hands\-on exposure to biometric equipment (fingerprint, iris, facial), passport readers, CCTV/NVR systems, access\-control readers, and visa\-processing applications.
* Awareness of ITIL service\-management practices (incident, request, change) and ability to follow them under central direction.
* Familiarity with enterprise ticketing tools such as Jira, Freshdesk, ServiceNow, or similar, including detailed ticket logging and SLA\-driven follow\-through.

title: Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Application Engineer, Physical Design
* Associate Applications Engineer, Silicon Design
* Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
* Technical Support Engineer, Physical Design
* Applications Engineer, Digital Implementation


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are early in your career but already know that the most interesting problems in chip design are not the ones in the textbook, they are the ones that show up when a customer is three weeks from tapeout and their timing is not closing. You have spent time in internships or academic projects working with ASIC flows, and you learned that understanding the theory is only half the job. The other half is figuring out what went wrong, why the tool did what it did, and how to explain it clearly enough that the person on the other end of the call can actually fix it.
   

  

 You are curious. When something breaks, you do not just escalate it, you dig in. You look at the logs, reproduce the issue, and try to understand the root cause before asking for help. You are comfortable learning new tools and flows without perfect documentation because you know how to read through examples, ask smart questions, and connect the dots. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers and internal teams on real chip design challenges, learning from experienced engineers while solving problems that matter. This is where you build the foundation that turns you into the engineer customers call when things get hard.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide technical support to customers using Synopsys Physical Design tools, helping them resolve issues in their ASIC development flows
* Diagnose and troubleshoot customer problems by analyzing design data, tool logs, and flow configurations to isolate root causes
* Work closely with internal product engineering and R\&D teams to reproduce issues, suggest workarounds, and escalate bugs that need fixes
* Respond to customer requests during critical design schedules, providing timely solutions or workarounds that keep projects moving
* Build working knowledge of Synopsys Physical Design tools and methodologies through hands\-on customer engagements and internal training
* Participate in customer deployments and training sessions, helping teams adopt Synopsys tools and best practices
* Document technical issues, solutions, and customer feedback to improve internal knowledge bases and inform product improvements


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Help customers meet their tapeout schedules by resolving technical issues that would otherwise block their progress
* Improve the quality and usability of Synopsys tools by surfacing real customer pain points to product engineering and R\&D
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by delivering reliable, timely technical support during critical project phases
* Contribute to the development of better methodologies and reference flows based on what you learn from customer deployments
* Accelerate your own technical growth by working on diverse customer designs across different process nodes and design styles
* Strengthen customer relationships by being responsive, thorough, and solution\-oriented even when the problem is not straightforward
* Support the broader Applications Engineering team by taking ownership of support cases and learning to handle more complex issues over time


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field
* At least 6 months to 1 year of internship or contractor experience in a global or multinational company, ideally in semiconductor or EDA
* Solid understanding of Physical Design flow, including placement, routing, timing, and basic optimization concepts
* Strong foundation in digital circuits, CMOS fundamentals, and ASIC design flow from RTL to GDSII
* Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic scripting for automation and debugging
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and colleagues
* Experience with Synopsys Physical Design tools such as Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, PrimeTime, or StarRC is a plus but not required


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can take a vague customer description like "the tool is crashing" and turn it into a specific reproducer with logs and data
* Comfortable asking questions when you do not know something, but you also try to figure it out yourself first
* You stay organized when managing multiple support cases and know which ones need immediate attention versus which can wait
* You do not get frustrated when the answer is not obvious, you treat it as a puzzle worth solving
* Reliable enough that when you say you will follow up with a customer by end of day, it actually happens
* Open to domestic and international travel for customer visits, training, and onsite support when needed


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Silicon Design \& Verification Applications Engineering team, working with experienced engineers who support customers on Physical Design flows and tools. This team collaborates closely with R\&D, product engineering, and global AE teams to solve customer problems and improve Synopsys solutions. Your recruiter will share more about team structure, mentorship, and growth opportunities during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required.
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success.


****Nice to Have****
* Proven track record supporting high\-impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business or IT lead, and/or business sponsor.
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in service delivery management and/or systems implementation

* Work from anywhere culture which allows flexible work location

description:
**Department:**

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced IT Support Specialist – Senior to lead high\-quality end\-user support, hardware troubleshooting, and application assistance across Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms. Beyond hands\-on resolution, this role owns AV operations governance, mentors junior support staff, drives process and automation improvements across the end user onsite support and service desk, and works closely with internal teams and vendors to ensure seamless, scalable IT service delivery and continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**End\-User \& IT Support:**
* Provide Level 2/3 support for laptops (hardware diagnostics, replacements, vendor coordination) and act as the escalation point for complex or repeat issues.

* Managed imaging, OS deployment, software installation, driver updates, and post\-deployment validation.
* Coordinated with imaging, networking, and security teams to ensure smooth migration
* Support internal and SaaS\-based applications, including email, VPNs, printers, and network connectivity.
* Own and continuously improve IT ticketing workflows to track incidents and service requests, identifying recurring issues for permanent fixes.
* Build and maintain documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting playbooks; review and standardize documentation created by junior team members.
* Lead workstation visits for physical connectivity or issue diagnosis and act as senior point of contact for new hire setup (monitors and other asset installation).


**Gen AI \& Automation for End\-User Support and Service Desk Operations**
* Identify repetitive, high\-volume ticket categories (password resets, access requests, standard hardware issues) and design automation or self\-service workflows to reduce manual effort.

* Proven hands\-on experience in Automation on service improvements and volume reduction.
* Evaluate and pilot Gen AI\-powered tools (AI chatbots, virtual agents, knowledge\-based copilots) for L1/L2 query deflection and faster first\-response times.

* Partner with IT Infrastructure and vendors to implement automated asset lifecycle workflows (auto\-provisioning, auto\-ticket routing, auto\-CMDB updates) to reduce manual tracking errors.
* Analyse ticket trends and service desk metrics using AI/analytics tools to proactively flag recurring problems and recommend root\-cause fixes.
* Automated routine administrative activities using PowerShell, Workflows and AI Tools


**IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle Management, Audits and Compliance**
* Own the full lifecycle of IT hardware assets from request, procurement, deployment, refresh, return, and disposal.
* Ensure all assets are accurately recorded and maintained in the CMDB/Asset Management System, drive data accuracy audits.
* Track ownership, location, warranty, lifecycle status, and asset tags.
* Drive inventory hygiene, OOW disposal, and laptop readiness tracking; manage spare inventory with 100% matching on procurement versus allocation.
* Lead periodic physical and system\-based asset audits and report on compliance gaps.
* Ensure PC refresh activities follow policy, and CMDB records remain accurate.


**Audio\-Visual (AV) Support**
* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot AV equipment for meetings and events, including complex or executive\-level setups, Tow\-Halls setup and Management.
* Support audio systems, microphones, and video conferencing solutions; troubleshoot escalations from junior AV support staff.
* Ensure flawless AV execution for in\-person and virtual events, including contingency planning for critical meetings.


**Collaboration \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with IT Infrastructure, AV, Security, and Facilities teams on cross\-functional initiatives, representing the service desk in planning discussions.
* Coordinate with and manage third\-party vendors for warranty claims, service fulfilment, and SLA adherence.
* Ensure hardware call logs are placed on time with no impact to users; own BAU continuity for the support function.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (B.Sc., B.Tech.) or diploma in Computer Science, Electronics, AV, or related fields.
* 10–12 years of hands\-on IT support experience across multi\-OS environments, including experience mentoring or leading junior support staff.
* Proficient in troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and Linux (Mandatory Requirement).
* Experience in Windows, macOS, Office 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management tools (e.g., Intune, SCCM, JAMF).
* Experience of networking fundamentals and remote access technologies (VPN, VDI, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of Active Directory, remote support tools, and endpoint security practices.
* Hands\-on experience implementing Gen AI or automation tools (chatbots, RPA, workflow automation) within an IT support or service desk environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to guide and coach junior team members.
* 5 Days Work from Office in a Week (No work from home option).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Apple ACSP, ITIL Foundation/Intermediate is a plus.
* Experience supporting hybrid (remote \+ in\-office) workforce environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, asset management tools, and service desk automation/AI platforms (e.g., ServiceNow AI, Microsoft Copilot, chatbot tools).

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are looking for a talented and driven Implementation Engineer to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design and implement integration solutions, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to deliver tailored solutions for our enterprise clients. You will serve as the subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform components, working alongside customers, project managers, solution consultants, and teams across different geographies to deliver seamless automations, custom solutions, and integrations.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Two or more years of experience in Enterprise Content Professional Services.
* one or more years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and testing API integrations and solutions, with above average knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Web Service Consumption, SOQL, and Salesforce Reporting.
* Expert knowledge of Excel Model, SSO, SMTP, SCIM and Salesforce Setup.
* Expert knowledge of LiveDoc \& LiveForm is preferred.
* Ability to lead projects with teams located in different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering efforts on large\-scale projects.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with a proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels.
* Self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrates strong self\-learning capabilities with the aptitude to quickly grasp new product features, technologies, and concepts.
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capability.
* Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Understanding of New Product Development Methodologies and Emerging Technologies (Mobile, Security, Internet, etc.).
* Strong facilitation, project management, and organisational skills.
* Strong relationship development and people management skills.
* Experience collaborating with and providing business recommendations to management.
* Comfortable writing and troubleshooting Python code snippets.
* Experience utilising AI tools and building agents to drive efficiency and quality improvement.
* Experience in the Business Requirements Creation Process for a technical product or similar experience.
* Experience with Seismic or another Sales Enablement platform is a plus.
* Experience in Product Management on a Technical Product is a plus.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Collaborate with business development, product management, and engineering teams to create and deploy integration solutions for complex client needs.
* Lead requirement gathering sessions with enterprise customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and integration objectives.
* Serve as subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform capabilities, APIs, out\-of\-the\-box offerings, and custom integrations.
* Provide strategic and hands\-on technical guidance to clients throughout the evaluation, implementation, and post\-deployment phases.
* Communicate and present solutions effectively to client executives and technical teams.
* Serve as technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes in collaboration with cross\-functional teams across different geographies.
* Identify and mitigate risks in technical workstreams, escalating critical issues as needed.
* Develop creative, robust, scalable, and reusable strategies to support evolving business needs.
* Deliver ongoing support and services for existing customers in alignment with SLAs; manage customer escalations while seeking technical resolution.
* Conduct virtual and on\-site training sessions to enable customer success.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advocate for customer\-driven enhancements and feature requests.
* Seek out new industry and technology trends and apply this knowledge to solve business problems.


**What we have for you:**

title: Consultant - Veeva Safety - Managed Services (Remote)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

**The Role**
**Managed Services** 
 is provided to our R\&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
   

  

 Our
 **Managed Services Team** 
 comprises 90\+ consultants in Europe, of which 5\+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
   

  

 Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
   

  

**As a Safety Consultant** 
 , you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
   

  

**To thrive in this role** 
 , you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .
   

  

 This is a remote, full\-time role with Veeva with occasional travel to the Veeva Hyderabad site.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Help to keep up to date and implement new features within the Veeva Safety suite
* Work closely with customer business and IT staff to understand their requirements
* Think critically to help design the solution your customers request as well as the solution they have not requested but may need
* Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams
* Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post\-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer
* Drive change management methodology for our customers switching from on\-premises to SaaS solutions


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations
* Must have a decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any home\-grown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in the previous employments
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success


****Nice to Have****
* Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health Insurance fully covered for family, including Employee’s parents
* Work anywhere culture which allows flexible work location
* Fitness benefits fully taken care by Veeva
* 1% Charitable giving program


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
