**Position Overview**
 Executive Support \& IT Operations provides end\-to\-end L1, L2, and L3 technical support, with a strong focus on Executive/VIP Support. The role supports Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, Windows and macOS endpoints, Exchange Online, Zoom and Zoom Rooms, Jira Service Management, PagerDuty, and SharePoint. Responsibilities include resolving complex incidents, managing executive devices and technology refreshes, supporting leadership meetings and company events, administering user access and endpoint policies, and improving support operations through documentation, reporting, and PowerShell automation. The engineer also mentors junior team members and collaborates with global IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and customer\-focused technology services.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Zelis is seeking an experienced
 **IT Support Engineer** 
 to provide combined
 **L1, L2, and L3 technical support** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **Executive/VIP White Glove Support and IT Operations** 
 .
   

  

 This role will serve as a trusted technology partner for executives, executive assistants, employees, and global IT teams. The engineer will own technical issues from initial intake through resolution while providing proactive, discreet, and highly responsive support across Microsoft technologies, endpoints, collaboration platforms, incidents, events, automation, and service improvement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Executive and VIP Support
   

  

* Provide personalized, high\-priority technical support for executives, executive assistants, senior leaders, and designated VIP users.
* Manage Jira VIP incidents and service requests, ensuring rapid acknowledgement, clear communication, appropriate escalation, and timely resolution.
* Support executive Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, peripherals, connectivity, and collaboration tools.
* Proactively manage executive device health, including patching, performance checks, security compliance, laptop replacements, warranty reviews, and hardware lifecycle planning.
* Coordinate executive technology replacements, data transfers, application validation, and post\-deployment follow\-up with minimal business disruption.
* Provide onsite support for executive visits, leadership meetings, webinars, and company town halls.
* Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion while maintaining end\-to\-end ownership of executive escalations.


 L1, L2, and L3 Technical Support
   

  

* Deliver full\-spectrum support covering L1 intake and triage, L2 advanced troubleshooting, and L3 escalation and root\-cause analysis.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, identity, access, endpoint, application, and connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot complex Windows and macOS incidents using diagnostic tools, system logs, administrative consoles, and endpoint\-management platforms.
* Own incidents and service requests through closure, coordinating with infrastructure, networking, security, application, and vendor teams when required.
* Document troubleshooting, resolution steps, business impact, and root cause accurately in Jira Service Management.
* Identify recurring issues and implement improvements that increase first\-contact resolution and reduce repeat incidents.


 Microsoft and Endpoint Administration
   

  

* Manage and support Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including virtual machines, user accounts, groups, identity services, endpoints, and device policies.
* Administer and troubleshoot Exchange Online, including mailboxes, permissions, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, email, and calendar issues.
* Support employee onboarding, access changes, and offboarding in coordination with HR, security, and application owners.
* Manage endpoint configuration, software deployment, patching, compliance, and device health using ManageEngine Endpoint Central and related tools.
* Develop and enforce IT security, endpoint, and operational policies aligned with compliance and enterprise technology standards.


 Zoom and Event Support
   

  

* Administer Zoom Meetings, Zoom Webinars, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom licensing, including scheduling, configuration, troubleshooting, reporting, and account management.
* Perform conference\-room and Zoom Room health checks covering displays, cameras, microphones, controllers, software, licensing, and connectivity.
* Provide rehearsal, presenter, and live\-event support for webinars, executive meetings, leadership sessions, and company town halls.
* Coordinate with executive assistants, communications, facilities, vendors, and global IT teams to ensure successful event delivery.
* Maintain backup technology and contingency plans for high\-visibility meetings and events.


 Incident and Service Management
   

  

* Participate in PagerDuty on\-call incident management, acknowledging, troubleshooting, documenting, and coordinating incidents within defined SLAs.
* Support major incidents by assessing business impact, engaging resolver teams, communicating status, and assisting with service restoration.
* Manage Jira stories, Jira Service Management queues, and Confluence content, ensuring work is prioritized, tracked, and completed.
* Monitor ticket ageing, VIP requests, escalations, SLA risks, and recurring support trends.
* Participate in incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous\-improvement initiatives.


 Knowledge, Training, and Zenius Bar Operations
   

  

* Create and maintain Executive Support documentation, knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, and Jira canned responses.
* Deliver new\-hire IT orientation sessions for employees across India and the United States, covering technology setup, access, security, collaboration tools, and support processes.
* Support the Hyderabad Zenius Bar, including ticket monitoring, employee assistance, technician training, survey analysis, and operational reporting.
* Develop and maintain Zenius Bar reporting in SharePoint, providing centralized access to metrics, schedules, documentation, and management reports.
* Promote knowledge sharing, self\-service adoption, and consistent support practices across the organization.


 Automation and Leadership
   

  

* Use PowerShell to automate user administration, device checks, reporting, data collection, and repetitive support activities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve service speed, strengthen reliability, and enhance the employee and executive technology experience.
* Mentor junior engineers and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with global infrastructure, security, end\-user computing, service desk, networking, and application teams.
* Build strong relationships with executives, employees, and stakeholders through clear communication, accountability, and customer\-focused support.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in enterprise IT support, desktop support, end\-user computing, or service\-desk operations.
* Demonstrated experience providing Executive/VIP Support.
* Ability to perform L1, L2, and L3 responsibilities and manage issues through complete resolution.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, identity and access administration, endpoint management, Windows, and macOS.
* Experience supporting Zoom Meetings, Webinars, Zoom Rooms, and conference\-room technology.
* Working knowledge of Jira Service Management, Confluence, PagerDuty, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SharePoint, and PowerShell.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and handle confidential information appropriately.
* Ability to provide onsite, on\-call, after\-hours, and event support based on business requirements.
* Bachelor’s degree, technical diploma, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting executives in a global, healthcare, financial\-services, or regulated organization.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge\-management practices.
* Experience supporting employees and teams across India and the United States.
* Microsoft, Zoom, ITIL, endpoint\-management, Windows, macOS, or related certifications.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and using operational metrics to improve IT services.


 Core Technologies
   

  

**Microsoft Azure \| Microsoft 365 \| Exchange Online \| ManageEngine Endpoint Central \| Jira Service Management \| Confluence \| Zoom \| Zoom Webinars \| Zoom Rooms \| PagerDuty \| SharePoint \| PowerShell \| Windows \| macOS**

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 As an IAM Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in securing Charles Schwab’s enterprise identity ecosystem by supporting authentication, authorization, and privileged access services that enable secure access for employees, contractors, and business applications. You will work closely with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and application teams to troubleshoot complex identity issues, improve service reliability, and automate operational processes. This role offers an opportunity to work with modern Identity and Access Management technologies while contributing to Schwab’s mission of protecting client and enterprise assets. If you are passionate about cybersecurity, automation, and solving technical challenges in a collaborative environment, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your IAM career
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

title: Software Asset Management Analyst I
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst I is the front line of the software service, working the high\-volume request queues to tight turnaround targets: listed software requests within 3 days, standard SaaS provisioning within 1 day, and licence\-issue resolution for users who cannot get into the software they need. The role is measured on speed and accuracy — the queue is large enough that consistency matters more than individual heroics, and errors here surface later as compliance gaps or duplicate spend.
   

  

 The associate works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts under that shift's Level III lead, with a Level II analyst mentoring day to day. Five of these roles exist — one on APAC and two each on EMEA and NAMER. The role is deliberately bounded: anything carrying legal, privacy or commercial judgment — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases, contract events — is escalated rather than decided, and knowing where that line sits is a core competency of the job.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Listed Software Request Fulfilment
* Execute listed\-software requests via storefront and ticket queues, consistently achieving the 3\-day turnaround SLA.
* Optimize license utilization by identifying reusable entitlements before proceeding with new fulfillment or procurement.
* Validate requester eligibility against product constraints and delivery restrictions to ensure compliant fulfillment.
* Maintain real\-time accuracy of asset and entitlement records throughout the license lifecycle.
* SaaS Provisioning \& Access Verification
* Fulfill standard SaaS requests within 24 hours, verifying active user access prior to ticket closure.
* Apply precise account tiering (e.g., Developer vs. Collaborator) to match publisher\-specific license structures.
* Audit automated provisioning outputs, proactively flagging and resolving failures to prevent service gaps.
* Manage routine deprovisioning; escalate complex scenarios involving data\-loss risks to Level II analysts.
* Licence Issue Resolution \& User Support
* Resolve technical license issues—including activation and access errors—within shift\-specific resolution targets.
* Guide users through software deployment, including the configuration of hosted floating\-license pools.
* Escalate server\-side technical issues to Level III and commercial/legal inquiries to Level II with detailed context.
* Deliver clear, professional user support to drive high customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
* Queue Hygiene, Data Handling \& Documentation
* Uphold rigorous ticket hygiene and category coding to ensure accurate reporting and trend analysis.
* Protect sensitive data by immediately transferring tickets containing keys or audit info to private queues.
* Enforce operational boundaries by escalating unlisted software and high\-risk use cases rather than self\-actioning.
* Proactively monitor intake forms to flag ageing items for handover before the shift window closes.
* Adhere strictly to SOPs while contributing improvements to the shared knowledge base.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Listed Software Turnaround: fulfil listed\-software requests within the 3\-day target.
* SaaS Provisioning Turnaround: complete standard SaaS provisioning within the 1\-day target, with user access verified before closure.
* First\-Time\-Right: sustain high accuracy on catalogue item, edition, quantity and tier selection, since rework here creates duplicate spend and compliance noise.
* Escalation Discipline: 100% of bounded exclusions — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases — escalated rather than actioned.
* Data Handling: 100% of sensitive tickets moved to the private queue on identification.
* Ticket Hygiene: correct category coding and complete records on every ticket worked.
* Customer Satisfaction: meet the shift's customer satisfaction and time\-to\-resolve targets.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* Queue \& Ticketing: the enterprise ticketing queue system with category coding, issue tracking, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Storefront \& Provisioning: the internal software storefront and catalogue, and the provisioning and automated deprovisioning platforms.
* Entitlement Records: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and assignment records.
* Reference \& Knowledge: the SOP knowledge base, product catalogue and publisher playbooks.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Mandatory**
* 1–3\+ years in IT service desk, software provisioning, asset administration or a comparable high\-volume transactional operations role.
* Demonstrated accuracy and throughput on a ticket\-based queue against defined turnaround targets.
* Basic understanding of software licensing concepts — entitlement, assignment, seat counts and the difference between installed and SaaS delivery.
* Sound judgment about the limits of the role: able to recognise a request that must be escalated rather than fulfilled.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear, courteous English communication with end users.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to software asset management or IT asset management tooling (Flexera, ServiceNow SAM).
* Experience with an enterprise software storefront or self\-service catalogue.
* Familiarity with major publisher provisioning flows and account tiering.
* Spreadsheet proficiency for tracker and reporting support.
* Foundation\-level ITIL or software asset management certification, or working towards one.

title: Human Resources Information System Specialist
description:
A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Human Resources Information System Specialist to own the HR technology backbone for a centre that is scaling past two thousand employees this year.
 



**The systems you would run** 



* Administer and configure the core HRIS (employee records, org structure, workflows, approvals) across every India entity the centre supports
* Own end to end data integrity for hires, transfers, promotions and exits, including audit trails for statutory reporting
* Build and maintain integrations between the HRIS, payroll, benefits and time and attendance platforms
* Manage user access, security roles and periodic access reviews in line with the parent company's global controls



**What breaks when HRIS data is wrong** 




 Payroll runs late, statutory filings get flagged, and managers lose trust in headcount numbers used for budgeting. This role exists to make sure that never happens by catching data issues before they reach downstream systems, and by building validation checks that flag anomalies automatically rather than waiting for someone to notice a mismatched report.
 



**What we need from day one** 




 Two to five years working directly inside an HRIS platform (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox or similar), strong Excel and reporting skills, comfort writing SOPs for a global stakeholder base, and the judgment to know when a data anomaly is a typo versus a process gap that needs escalating. Experience supporting a multinational or GCC environment is a strong plus.
 



 Based out of Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune or Remote (India), with periodic travel to other India office locations as the centre grows.
 



**After you apply** 




 The process runs HR Screening, followed by a data and systems assignment, a hiring manager conversation, and a short culture round with the India HR leadership team.
 



 One application is kept on file and considered against this role as well as future HRIS and HR technology openings that come up across Flexiple's client roster.

description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?** 



  


 Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform. 
 


  


 In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
 


  


 We started in Manchester and now we’re global \- with teams across the UK, US and India.
 


  


 We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.
 


  





  




 Role Purpose
   


  


 As an IT Service Desk Analyst in our Hyderabad office, you will be the primary point of contact for our US\-based team during their business hours, while also picking up and resolving support tickets raised by our global workforce.
 **Please note: this role covers US business hours, which means working night shifts from our Hyderabad office.** 
 This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of AI\-driven support, collaborating with Felix — our AI virtual teammate — to maintain a high\-velocity, high\-quality service queue.
 


  


 Your team will leverage advanced AI tools like Claude, Gemini and n8n to automate routine workflows and triage incidents, allowing you to focus your expertise on resolving technical challenges across Windows, macOS, and our SaaS ecosystem. You will operate with significant autonomy as the sole Service Desk analyst on shift, backed by a global IT network across the UK and India, ensuring seamless handovers and collaborative problem\-solving.
 


  


 We are seeking a proactive professional who takes complete ownership of the user experience, blending human technical intuition with AI efficiency to deliver world\-class support in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
 


  






  




**What You Will Be Doing** 
  


**Ticket Ownership \& Technical Support:** 
 Be the primary point of contact for the Service Desk during US hours, triaging and independently troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and application issues across Windows and macOS — supporting our global workforce, with a focus on the US\-based team during your shift.
 


  


**Partnering with Felix:** 
 Work alongside Felix, our AI virtual Service Desk teammate, picking up tickets it can't fully resolve and using its triage and summaries to work efficiently. Continuously look for opportunities to improve automation and self\-service.
 


  


**SLA Management \& Escalation:** 
 Own tickets end\-to\-end in the ITSM system, working to ITIL/ITSM best practice and meeting SLA targets, escalating to the wider IT team in the UK — or to third\-line specialists and external vendors — only where genuinely necessary, with full context handed over.
 


  


**Identity \& Endpoint Management:** 
 Execute secure user provisioning and device lifecycle management using Okta, Jamf, and Microsoft Intune to maintain fleet compliance and security integrity.
 


  


**SaaS Platform Administration:** 
 Administer core SaaS platforms — including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence) — managing users, access, configuration, and licensing.
 


  


**Onboarding \& Offboarding:** 
 Work closely with PeopleOps to onboard and offboard users as they join or leave the organisation, ensuring provisioning and de\-provisioning is completed accurately and on time.
 


  


**AI \& Automation Tooling:** 
 Use AI assistants such as Claude and Gemini, and automation platforms such as n8n, to speed up triage, draft responses, summarise incidents, and automate repetitive workflows; suggest new areas where automation could reduce manual effort.
 


  


**Cross\-Timezone Handover \& Documentation:** 
 Maintain clear, accurate handover notes for the wider IT Service Desk team covering open escalations, overnight developments, and anything requiring follow\-up; maintain and improve knowledge base articles and documentation.
 


  


**Change \& Project Support:** 
 Take ownership of smaller changes and contribute to larger IT projects — system upgrades, deployments, and migrations — including testing, documentation, and rollout.
 


  


  




**What We Are Looking For** 
  

 Technical / Role Specific — Essential
   


 2–4 years' experience in a 2nd line or standalone IT support role, with a track record of resolving complex issues independently rather than simply triaging them.
 


  


 Strong working knowledge of both Windows and macOS environments.
 


  


 Hands\-on experience administering an identity provider (e.g. Okta or similar) and an MDM platform (e.g. Jamf, Intune).
 


  


 Comfortable working within ITIL/ITSM frameworks and using a ticketing system such as Jira Service Management, with a genuine understanding of SLAs and the ability to work effectively within them.
 


  


 Practical experience with core SaaS platforms: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and the Atlassian suite.
 


  


 Comfortable using AI assistants (e.g. Claude, Gemini) as part of daily troubleshooting, documentation, and communication, and genuinely enthusiastic about working alongside an AI virtual teammate (Felix) rather than seeing it as a threat.
 


  


 A self\-starter who can review and improve business processes, take ownership of IT initiatives, and prioritise workload based on urgency and impact.
 


  


  




**Desirable** 
  


 Experience with Confluence for documentation and knowledge base management.
 


  


 Exposure to workflow automation tooling such as n8n, or a strong enthusiasm to learn it, to build or improve automations.
 


  


 Experience with endpoint security / EDR tooling (e.g. CrowdStrike).
 


  


 Experience working in a SaaS\-first, multi\-office, or globally distributed organisation, including handing over work across time zones.
 


  


 Experience with software licence audits and vendor management.
 


  


 Familiarity with formal change management processes and change tickets.
 


  


  




**Personal Capabilities Required** 
  


 This role covers US business hours (night shift) and is based in our Hyderabad office.
 


  


 Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy as the only Service Desk analyst on shift, with the judgement to know when to handle something yourself and when to escalate to the wider IT team in the UK, rather than relying on a local backup.
 


  


 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for non\-technical stakeholders and write clear handover notes for colleagues in other time zones.
 


  


 A genuine sense of ownership — proactively drives tickets and projects to resolution rather than waiting to be told what to do.
 


  


 Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and stay organised under pressure.
 


  


 The business invests significantly in personal development; a strong desire to use these opportunities and turn new skills into continual service improvement is important to success.

 We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work\-life balance, with benefits including:

**Overview**
**Senior Cloud Specialist**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Cloud Specialist is primarily responsible for responding to and resolving cases from customers, partners, and the company's services team. This role independently manages incidents and service requests, troubleshoots complex cloud issues, and works cross\-functionally within cloud environments. The Senior Cloud Specialist serves as a trusted advisor and escalation resource, driving proactive improvements to cloud operations while ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
   

  

**Please note:** 
 This role operates on a 24x7 rotational shift schedule based on roster.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Serve as a primary escalation resource for team members and customers, resolving complex cloud\-hosted solution requests received via tickets, phone, and email while applying best practice knowledge.
* Take proactive measures to identify trends, improve monitoring of cloud\-hosted solutions, and enhance internal efficiencies — remaining current on emerging best practices.
* Operate as a trusted advisor on scheduled environment refresh requests, assisting customers, partners, and internal resources while applying best practices throughout the process.
* Develop and implement enhancements to audit information gathering, ensuring compliance with established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines.
* Assist with implementing, testing, and maintaining systems and processes related to the cloud business continuity and disaster recovery plan.
* Mentor, coach, and train team members; develop internal documentation that fully reflects all activity related to issue resolution and the maintenance of hosted systems.


**Role Essentials**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with demonstrated experience in process improvement and resolving complex technical issues.
* ITIL4 Foundation certification with working knowledge of Service Request and Incident Management practices.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Server environments, including Microsoft Active Directory, networking, storage, and virtualization technologies.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate goals into innovative design solutions.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, maintaining professionalism and discretion at all times.


**What We'd Like to See**
* Hands\-on experience with cloud environments and tools such as Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Remedy, Dynatrace, Splunk, and AWS services.
* Demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, and mobilize team members and business partners, both independently and in a team environment.
* Experience developing comprehensive internal documentation related to issue resolution and hosted system maintenance.
* Proven track record of proactively identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements while staying current on industry best practices.
* Ability to provide general consulting services as a trusted advisor, leveraging deep expertise and best practice knowledge across cloud operations.


**About Hyland**
 Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.

title: Engineer I - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 Want to learn AWS by running it at a Tier 1 financial firm? As Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be first on the ticket — triaging requests, running runbooks, and shadowing incidents — with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support right beside you and a clear certification path to Engineer 2\. If you're hungry to grow into a serious cloud engineer with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 1, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on entry\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. Under close guidance from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support, you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, execute runbooks, fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests, and act as a supported first\-line responder in the 24x7 on\-call rotation. You partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks, and you escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s and above when work is beyond your current scope. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on and learning — progressing along the Engineer 1 certification path (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Terraform Associate, KCNA) toward Engineer 2 — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs under guidance: own well\-scoped Tier 1 requests end\-to\-end and escalate cleanly to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and the VP, Support when work is beyond your current scope
* Fulfill well\-scoped account / IAM / access requests using the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library, following established runbooks
* Execute runbooks for known incident classes and help keep them accurate; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to capture what you learn
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation and ServiceNow change\-record discipline under senior review
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage, runbook lookup and generation, MCP\-driven self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on entry\-level cloud engineer under close guidance: spend the majority of your time on well\-scoped Terraform changes, AWS console / CLI tasks, ticket and runbook execution, and shadowing incident response — building core cloud skills is the primary focus
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder, following runbooks and escalating early to Engineer 2s, AVPs, and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship small, well\-scoped changes; raise focused pull requests that a senior engineer reviews before merge
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework to the work you touch under senior guidance
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), and Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) — progressing toward Engineer 2 over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of technical experience in cloud, infrastructure, or software engineering (internship / co\-op / bootcamp experience counts); Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* Foundational AWS exposure and a demonstrated willingness to learn Terraform in a private module ecosystem delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated ability to complete well\-scoped technical tasks under guidance, with reliable follow\-through and a strong learning mindset
* Willingness to participate in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a supported first\-line responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Familiarity with an ITSM / ticketing workflow (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable) and a strong customer\-service orientation toward application teams


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 1 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and treats every ticket and incident as a learning loop
* Highly coachable; acts on feedback and improves quickly
* Asks for help early rather than struggling alone, and documents what they learn for the next engineer
* Reliable, careful execution on well\-scoped work
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds trusting relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Clear written and verbal communication in tickets and pull requests


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 1 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* Exposure to agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day work
* Scripting exposure in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC

title: Sr. Service Engineer
description:
Service Engineer 2 — Hardware Asset Management
   

  

 Endpoint Onboarding, Testing \& Asset Lifecycle \| Endpoint Engineering Services \| Hyderabad \| 2–4 years
   

  

 ROLE PURPOSE
   

  

 Execute the hands\-on work that gets new endpoint hardware certified and keeps the asset record honest. You will test candidate laptops, desktops, thin clients and peripherals against a defined certification suite, package and validate driver and firmware updates, and maintain accurate lifecycle records — working under the direction of a Senior Service Engineer who owns the standard.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Run certification testing. Execute the test checklist on new laptop, desktop, thin client, zero client and peripheral models. Capture results, defects and evidence in a consistent, reviewable format.
* Validate build and deployment readiness. Confirm Autopilot and MECM enrolment, driver packs, imaging and OS readiness on candidate hardware — Windows 11, IGEL OS, Dell ThinOS, HP ThinPro.
* Keep firmware, BIOS and drivers current. Package and test driver and BIOS updates, apply the approved BIOS/UEFI baseline, verify remote update paths, and track OEM advisories for the models you own.
* Test peripherals and clinical accessories. Docks, monitors, headsets, tap/badge readers, barcode scanners, label printers, carts and workstation\-on\-wheels configurations.
* Maintain asset accuracy. Keep HAM and CMDB records clean — serial and asset\-tag reconciliation, warranty and entitlement data, stockroom movements — and pull the evidence needed for audits.
* Support secure disposition. Prepare retiring devices for sanitisation and disposal with the approved method and complete chain\-of\-custody documentation.
* Document and support. Write SOPs, test reports and known\-issue notes; support L2/L3 escalations for hardware faults; raise and follow through OEM warranty and RMA cases.


**Skills And Experience We Need**
* 2–4 years in endpoint support or engineering in a mid\-to\-large enterprise.
* Windows 11 endpoints, hands\-on. Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune and Autopilot, or MECM/ConfigMgr.
* Hardware fundamentals. BIOS/UEFI settings, TPM, secure boot, drivers, firmware, docking and display behaviour — and the confidence to open a device and diagnose it.
* Some exposure to thin clients and virtual desktops. At least one thin client platform (IGEL, ThinOS, ThinPro) and one VDI or DaaS environment (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, Omnissa Horizon).
* OEM support processes. Dell TechDirect, HP or Lenovo support portals; warranty validation and RMA handling.
* Structured testing habits. You follow a test plan, record what actually happened, and write it up so someone else can act on it.
* ITSM and data discipline. ServiceNow ticket hygiene, plus solid spreadsheet skills for inventory and reconciliation work.


**Preferred**
* MD\-102, CompTIA A\+, or an OEM hardware certification (Dell / HP / Lenovo / IGEL); ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Exposure to asset tooling (ServiceNow HAM, Lansweeper, Flexera) or DEX tooling (Nexthink, ControlUp).
* Basic PowerShell for reporting and repetitive validation tasks.
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment with shared and clinical devices.


**How Success Is Measured**
* Test\-cycle turnaround time and completeness of test evidence.
* Defects that escape testing and surface after deployment.
* Accuracy of asset records against physical and discovered inventory.
* Quality and reuse of the SOPs and test reports you produce.
* Ticket and RMA closure within SLA.

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 When a production cloud incident hits a Tier 1 financial firm at 2 a.m., someone senior has to own it. As AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you're that person — the senior escalation point for LPL's run\-the\-cloud function, taking the hardest tickets and incidents end\-to\-end and turning recurring toil into automated, self\-service paths. If you want to operate AWS at scale with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on senior cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run\-the\-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi\-account landing zone. You are the senior escalation point for the Support team's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: you take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, own operational excellence, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in troubleshooting, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self\-service paths — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Operate as a hands\-on senior cloud support engineer: spend the majority of your time in production troubleshooting, runbook authoring and execution, Terraform changes, complex ticket resolution, and incident response — hands\-on operations is the primary leverage point
* Serve as the senior escalation point for the Support team's Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: take the hardest tickets and production incidents end\-to\-end, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. Turn recurring toil into durable fixes: convert repeatable account / IAM / access requests and incident classes into self\-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Own operational excellence for the run\-the\-cloud function: runbook quality, change\-management discipline in ServiceNow, post\-incident reviews, and SLA / operational metrics; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to close monitoring and alerting gaps. Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to raise the run\-the\-cloud bar: AI\-assisted triage and root\-cause analysis, MCP\-driven conversational self\-service for common requests, automated runbook generation, and on\-call copilots that summarize telemetry and chat during incidents
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a senior technical responder and escalation point for production incidents. Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to align roadmaps and remove cross\-team and cross\-pod blockers
* Raise engineering quality across the pod through code review, design partnership, and technical pairing — acting as a force multiplier without direct reports. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and partner with the RTE and PMO on delivery commitments and dependencies


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 12\+ years of progressive technical experience including 5\+ years in a senior cloud security, network security, or cloud infrastructure engineering role; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 5\+ years of hands\-on production AWS at scale in a multi\-account landing zone with strong production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor (AVP, Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent), influencing technical direction and uplifting peer engineers without direct authority — including code review leadership, design\-review participation, and technical mentorship
* Experience personally participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious, regulated environment (financial services strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated experience as a senior engineer on a production cloud operations / support function: leading incident response as an escalation point, owning change management (ServiceNow or comparable ITSM), and driving runbook and automation improvements that reduce toil


**Core Competencies**
* Player\-coach who is comfortable in code reviews, architecture sessions, and people 1:1s in the same day. Continuous learner, especially in cloud\-native, IaC, platform engineering, and applied AI
* Sets vision and translates ambiguous strategy into executable engineering roadmaps. Bias for self\-service, automation, and reducing toil for downstream internal customers
* Builds high\-trust relationships across the US and India organization and across functions (Architecture, Security, FinOps, Application Engineering, Network, Audit). Calm, decisive incident commander; fosters a strong post\-incident learning culture
* Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority. Thrives in matrixed, fast\-paced, regulated environments with imperfect information


**Preferences**
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or MBA. Experience building, scaling, or leading globally distributed engineering teams across the US and India / GCC
* Experience integrating agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) into platform, IaC, and engineering practice. Strong scripting / programming proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* AWS Solutions Architect \- Professional. AWS Certified Generative AI Developer \- Associate. Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\) or Authoring \& Operations. Open\-source contributions, public technical writing, or conference speaking on cloud, IaC, or platform engineering topics
* Experience with Backstage or another Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management at scale

The ideal candidate will be a technical expert with deep knowledge of enterprise applications, strong analytical abilities, and experience in healthcare benefits systems.
 



 You will serve as a critical escalation point for unresolved incidents, leading root cause analysis, troubleshooting complex integrations, and driving resolution through collaboration with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Success teams. Your work ensures system stability, data integrity, and exceptional customer experience in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex, high\-impact production issues reported by customers or internal teams.
* Conduct in\-depth root cause analysis (RCA) using application logs, database records, API traces, and system workflows.
* Reproduce and validate reported issues in staging or test environments to isolate technical and business\-process defects.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting across multi\-tiered systems, including backend services, databases, APIs, and integrations (e.g., HRIS, payroll, third\-party benefit providers).
* Write and execute complex SQL queries to analyze data anomalies, validate business logic, and support diagnostics.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to triage, document, and prioritize fixes; provide detailed technical feedback and reproducible test cases.
* Partner with Product and QA to clarify requirements, validate bug fixes, and support regression testing.
* Work with Customer Success to communicate technical status, timelines, and resolution strategies to stakeholders.
* Document findings, solutions, and knowledge base articles to improve team efficiency and reduce future escalations.
* Monitor system health and proactively identify potential issues through log analysis and performance trends.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or software engineering roles, with proven experience at Tier 3 or equivalent level.
* Deep understanding of benefits administration systems (e.g., health, dental, vision, retirement, FSA/HSA) and associated workflows.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL (query optimization, joins, subqueries, stored procedures) and database troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in analyzing logs (application, server, API), understanding system behavior, and identifying patterns in error messages.
* Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, web services, and integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Informatica, Zapier, etc.).
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automation and log parsing.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Helfie is on a mission to redefine global preventative healthcare.We’re pioneering an entirely new operating system for human health – empowering billons with instant, affordable health checks and AI\-driven insights. Our vision is to build trust, drive organic engagement, and make preventative healthcare a reality for all 8 billion of us.
 



  





 Join us as we revolutionise the healthcare landscape and make early detection and prevention accessible to everyone.
 



  





**About the role:** 




 As a Customer Support Engineer, you are the first human our users reach when something isn’t working, and the person who makes sure they leave the conversation reassured, understood and back on track. Helfie is a regulated health product, so the quality, accuracy, and care you bring to every interaction matters enormously. You won’t just close tickets, you’ll be the voice of the customer inside the company, turning recurring issues into product improvements.
 



  





 Based in Helfie’s Hyderabad office, this role sits at the intersection of our customers, product and engineering teams, owning the front line of support for a mobile app that millions trust with their health.
 



  





 You’ll operate within an AI Agent\-first organisation, where AI tools are embedded into daily workflows and every team member is expected to use them proactively to work faster and better.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Own the first\-line response to customer queries and issues across all support channels, providing timely, empathetic, and clear communication.

* Triage incoming issues: distinguish user error, configuration, and genuine product defects, gathering the right detail (steps to reproduce, device, screenshots, logs) before escalating.
* Escalate technical and platform issues to the engineering teams with clear, well\-documented tickets, and track them through to resolution on the customer’s behalf.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally \- surfacing recurring pain points and themes to product and engineering to drive improvements.

description:
Location \- Remote
 



 Reports to \- Senior Manager, Implementations, Brightedge
 



  





 BrightEdge is seeking an experienced
 **Site Agent Implementation Specialist (Senior)** 
 to lead the implementation, optimization, and long\-term success of Site Agent, one of BrightEdge's most strategic automation products. This role combines deep technical implementation expertise with customer relationship management and program ownership to deliver exceptional customer outcomes across Enterprise and Mid\-Market accounts.
 



  





 As the primary technical owner for a portfolio of Site Agent customers, you will manage implementations from technical discovery through go\-live and ongoing performance optimization. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers while partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to maximize adoption, retention, and business value.
 



  





 In addition to managing your own portfolio, you will help scale Site Agent across BrightEdge's customer base by leading new deployments, supporting strategic renewals, mentoring teammates, and contributing to product innovation.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement:** 
 This role requires regular customer\-facing coverage during
 **U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) and Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours** 
 . Candidates must be able to consistently support customers across these time zones as part of their regular working schedule.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Portfolio Ownership** 



* Own and manage a portfolio of Site Agent customer accounts across both New Logo and Existing Customer business.
* Take accountability for customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* Conduct regular customer touchpoints and quarterly business/performance reviews.
* Identify optimization opportunities and recommend SEO best practices to improve customer outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers on renewal and expansion strategies.



  





**Implementation \& Technical Delivery** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Site Agent implementations from kickoff through production deployment.
* Drive implementation workstreams involving:
* Client\-side JavaScript integrations
* Server\-side SDK implementations
* Sidecar and custom deployment models
* Coordinate technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Manage implementation timelines, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure successful production launches and post\-launch validation.



  





**Platform Configuration \& Optimization** 




 Configure and maintain Site Agent including:
 


* Profiles
* Source and target rules
* Priority ordering
* Anchor text logic
* Regex configuration
* Language settings
* Crawl configuration
* Page and link caps
* Additional domains



 Maintain high configuration accuracy, recognizing that every change is reflected on customer\-facing websites.
 



  





**Technical Troubleshooting** 



* Diagnose implementation and production issues using:
* Crawl data
* Site Agent Admin Panel
* Debug tools
* Regex validator
* Resolve implementation issues independently whenever possible.
* Escalate complex engineering issues with detailed technical documentation.
* Coordinate resolution of "AP Down" customer accounts and restore production health.



  





**Customer Success \& Strategic Consulting** 



* Conduct Quarterly Site Agent Performance Reviews.
* Review implementation health and KPIs.
* Deliver SEO recommendations based on customer performance.
* Reinforce the value of Site Agent automation, especially during periods of flat or declining performance.
* Support executive customer presentations including QBRs and EBRs.



  





**Cross\-Functional Partnership** 




 Collaborate closely with:
 


* Customer Success Managers
* Strategic Account Managers
* Sales
* Professional Services
* Product Management
* Engineering



 Support:
 


* Strategic renewals
* Competitive positioning
* Product adoption
* Technical discovery
* Executive customer presentations



**Product Growth \& Innovation** 



* Support rollout of new Site Agent capabilities including AP Schema and Site Agent for Mobile.
* Deploy Site Agent across new Enterprise and Mid\-Market customers.
* Participate in product feedback sessions with Engineering.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Share customer insights to influence future product direction.



**Team Leadership** 



* Mentor junior Implementation Specialists.
* Provide technical guidance during complex customer engagements.
* Share troubleshooting knowledge and implementation best practices.
* Support onboarding and cross\-training initiatives.



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or SEO technology.
* Experience managing Enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong project and program management experience.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer implementations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Experience documenting work in Salesforce or similar CRM systems.



  





  





**Preferred Technical Experience** 




 Experience with one or more of the following:
 


* JavaScript integrations
* Server\-side implementations
* SDK integrations
* REST APIs
* Regular Expressions (Regex)
* HTML/CSS fundamentals
* CMS platforms (Sitecore, Shopify, WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, etc.)
* React and modern web frameworks
* Website architecture
* Rendering concepts (client\-side vs server\-side)



  





  





**SEO Knowledge** 




 Working knowledge of:
 


* Internal linking
* Technical SEO
* On\-page optimization
* Structured Data / Schema
* Crawl behavior
* Website architecture
* Search engine indexing



  





  





**What Makes You Successful** 




 You are someone who:
 


* Thrives in customer\-facing technical environments.
* Balances technical depth with relationship management.
* Pays exceptional attention to detail.
* Can confidently present to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Communicates clearly across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Takes ownership from implementation through long\-term customer success.
* Enjoys solving complex technical problems.
* Can manage multiple high\-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* Brings a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys mentoring others.
